Open the option screen with the bound %s key.

§5§nUNDO§0§r
Holding down the bound %s key while looking at a blocks will show you the last blocks you placed with a green border around them. Pressing the bound %s key while looking at any of them will undo the operation, giving you all the items back. If you used the Destruction upgrade, it will restore the blocks.

§5§nCONTAINERS§0§r
Shulker boxes, bundles and many containers from other mods can provide building blocks for the stick.

§5§nOFFHAND PRIORITY§0§r
Having blocks in your offhand will place them instead of the block you're looking at.

en:
All versions. **A key optimization.** Newer Minecraft versions (after 1.12) implemented a blockstate cache system that caches frequently used information about a blockstate, such as whether it is solid, its collision shape, etc. Rebuilding this cache is quite fast in vanilla (it takes only a second or two) but is quite slow with many mods installed, as there are many more blockstates present in the game which all must have their caches rebuilt.

This problem is exacerbated by Forge as the cache is rebuilt at many points when the data would almost certainly be unused before the next rebuild. Examples include right before reaching the main menu (during the "Freezing data" stage), as well as multiple (!) times when a world is being loaded.

ModernFix solves this performance bottleneck by instead making cache rebuilds lazy. Each blockstate rebuilds its cache the first time the data would be accessed. At any point when vanilla or Forge would attempt to rebuild caches for all blockstates, this is redirected to simply invalidate the cache on each blockstate instead.

This should not have any impact on TPS after startup concludes.
before:
所有版本。**一項關鍵最佳化。**較新的 Minecraft 版本 (1.12 之後)實現了一個塊狀態快取系統，用於快取有關塊狀態的經常使用的資訊，例如它是否為實體，其碰撞形狀等。在原版中，重建此快取相當迅速(僅需一兩秒)，但在安裝了許多模組的情況下，由於遊戲中存在許多塊狀態，所有這些塊狀態都必須重新構建其快取，這會變得相當慢。

由於 Forge 會在幾乎可以確定在下一次重建之前不會使用資料的許多點上重建快取，這一問題在 Forge 上變得更為嚴重。這些點的示例包括在達到標題畫面之前(在「凍結資料」階段)以及在載入世界時(多次！)。

ModernFix 通過改為使快取重建變為惰性，解決了這個效能瓶頸。每個塊狀態在首次訪問資料時重建其快取。在任何時候當原版或 Forge 試圖為所有塊狀態重建快取時，這將被重新導向到僅使每個塊狀態上的快取失效。

en:
All versions. **A key optimization.** Launches on modern versions are heavily bottlenecked by filesystem access. Many requests are frequently made to resource packs to list resources or check if a given resource exists, and each of these result in a very slow file API call.

ModernFix completely eliminates most of the bottleneck here by simply caching a listing of all resources that exist within mod-provided and vanilla resourcepacks. The cache is rebuilt on resource reload (except for the vanilla resources, since they should never change while the game is running).

There are no known compatibility issues with this patch except for OptiFine (its CTM resources do not load correctly). However I do not recommend using OptiFine in any scenario, as it adds several minutes to launch time by itself and is not tested with ModernFix at all.

ModernFix 完全消除了這裡的大部分制約，僅通過簡單地快取所有存在於模組提供和原版資源包中的資源的清單來實現。快取在資源重新載入時重新構建(除了原版資源，因為它們在遊戲執行時應該永遠不會改變)。

對於這個補丁，目前沒有已知的相容性問題，除了 OptiFine(其 CTM 資源無法正確載入)。然而，我不建議在任何情況下使用 OptiFine，因為它本身會使啟動時間增加數分鐘，並且完全沒有與 ModernFix 測試過。

en:
1.16 & 1.19 only. **A key optimization.**

In the middle of the 1.16 development cycle, Forge patched the game to reload datapacks twice when loading an existing world, in order to fix an issue with biome ID shifting. Unfortunately, datapack reloads often take upwards of 30 seconds and so this very severely affects world loading times.

ModernFix makes the necessary changes to avoid this reload, based on the unfinished Forge PR #8163.

This change was removed by Forge in 1.18, but then a similar patch was added *again* in 1.19 to fix mod datapacks not being loaded when creating new singleplayer worlds. Fortunately, the issue is localized to the world creation screen in 1.19, and existing worlds only require a single reload. However, this still doubles the length of the lag spike when clicking "Create New World" in 1.19, and so ModernFix again makes changes to not perform a redundant reload.

en: Fertilized Essence $(bold)usually$() drops from all $(l:basics/resource_crops)Resource Crops$() $(bold)except Inferium$(). It works identically to Bonemeal, but also works on $(l:basics/resource_crops)Resource Crops$()! $(br2)Fertilized Essence can also be used to more efficiently craft $(l:advances/mystical_fertilizer)Mystical Fertilizer$().
before: 肥料精華$(bold)通常$()從所有$(l:basics/resource_crops)資源作物$()中掉落, 除了$(bold)下級精華$(). 它的工作原理與骨粉相同, 但也同樣作用於$(l:basics/resource_crops)資源作物$()! $(br2)肥料精華也可以用來更高效地合成$(l: advances/mystical_fertilizer)魔法肥料$().

en: Growth Accelerators are used to increase plant growth speed. They apply random growth ticks to the first plant placed above them within the specified range. $(br2)You can stack multiple Growth Accelerators of any tier as long as the plant is within range.
before: 生長加速器被用來提高植物的生長速度. 在特定範圍內，它們會增加被放置在它們上面的第一個植物的生長隨機刻. 你可以放置多個任意層級的生長加速器，只要植物在其範圍內.
why: 漏掉 $(br2) 格式碼，且「增加...生長隨機刻」語意不清。
sonnet_fix: 生長加速器用來提升植物的生長速度。它們會在指定範圍內，對放置在上方的第一個植物施加隨機生長刻。$(br2)只要植物在範圍內，你可以疊放多個任意階級的生長加速器。
after: 生長加速器用來提升植物的生長速度。它們會在指定範圍內，對放置在上方的第一個植物施加隨機生長刻。$(br2)只要植物在範圍內，你可以疊放多個任意階級的生長加速器。

en: Inferium Essence is one of the two base materials in Mystical Agriculture. It's used in the creation of pretty much everything in the mod. You can $(bold)usually$() obtain Inferium Essence by killing hostile or passive mobs, mining it from the ground, or growing it.
before: 下級精華是神秘農業中兩種基礎材料中的一種. 它被用在這個模組中的幾乎所有物品的合成中. 你$(bold )通常$()可以通過殺死敵對或中立生物, 在地下開採, 或是種植來獲得下級精華.
why: 格式碼「$(bold )」損壞，且 passive 誤譯為「中立」。
sonnet_fix: 下級精華是神秘農業中兩種基礎材料之一。這個模組中幾乎所有東西的合成都會用到它。你$(bold)通常$()可以透過擊殺敵對或被動生物、在地下開採或種植來獲得下級精華。
after: 下級精華是神秘農業中兩種基礎材料之一。這個模組中幾乎所有東西的合成都會用到它。你$(bold)通常$()可以透過擊殺敵對或被動生物、在地下開採或種植來獲得下級精華。

en: The Infusion Altar is a crafting structure that is $(bold)usually$() used to create Mystical Agriculture seeds. The structure consists of 1 Infusion Altar and 8 Infusion Pedestals. $(br2)Once you have a recipe put in place, you just need to activate the altar with a Wand or Redstone signal.
before: 注魔祭壇是一種$(bold)通常$()用來合成神秘農業的種子的功能結構. 這種結構包括1個注魔祭壇和8個注魔基座. $(br2)一旦你擺放了一個合適的合成配方, 你只需要用紅石信號激活注魔祭壇.
why: 漏譯 Wand（法杖）。
sonnet_fix: 注魔祭壇是一種$(bold)通常$()用來合成神秘農業種子的合成結構。這種結構包括1個注魔祭壇和8個注魔基座。$(br2)一旦擺好配方，你只需要用法杖或紅石信號啟動祭壇。
after: 注魔祭壇是一種$(bold)通常$()用來合成神秘農業種子的合成結構。這種結構包括1個注魔祭壇和8個注魔基座。$(br2)擺好配方後，你只需要用魔杖或紅石訊號啟動祭壇。

en: Placing the Infusion Altar in world will show you where to place your pedestals. $(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture/guides/creating-seeds)Click here for a detailed guide on using the Infusion Altar.$()
before: 在世界中放置注魔祭壇會向你展示如何放置基座.
why: 漏譯第二句與連結。
sonnet_fix: 在世界中放置注魔祭壇會告訴你該把基座放在哪裡。$(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture/guides/creating-seeds)點擊此處查看注魔祭壇的詳細使用指南。$()
after: 在世界中放置注魔祭壇會告訴你該把基座放在哪裡。$(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture/guides/creating-seeds)點擊此處查看注魔祭壇的詳細使用指南。$()

en: The Mining AOE Augment is a tool augment that increases the are that the tool breaks blocks, up to 9x9. $(br2)This effect can be negated by sneaking. $(br2)The center of the AOE can be changed by pressing CTRL + Arrow Keys.
before: 範圍挖掘升級是一種挖掘工具升級，會提升工具挖掘的範圍，最大可達9x9. 潛行時破壞方塊會無視這個範圍效果.
why: 漏譯最後一句（CTRL + 方向鍵改變中心）與 $(br2)。
sonnet_fix: 範圍挖掘升級是一種工具升級，會擴大工具破壞方塊的範圍，最大可達9x9。$(br2)潛行時可以取消這個效果。$(br2)按 CTRL + 方向鍵可以改變範圍的中心。
after: 範圍挖掘升級是一種工具升級，會擴大工具破壞方塊的範圍，最大可達9x9。$(br2)潛行時可以取消這個效果。$(br2)按 CTRL + 方向鍵可以改變範圍的中心。

en: Soul Jars are used in combination with a $(l:souls/soulium_dagger)Soulium Dagger$() to collect mob souls. Filled Soul Jars can be used to create $(l:basics/resource_crops)Resource Crops$() for the corresponding entity. $(br2)Soul Jars can also be filled using mob drops with a $(l:machines/soul_extractor)Soul Extractor$().
before: 靈魂瓶與$(l:souls/soulium_dagger)離魂匕首$()一起使用來收集生物的靈魂. 裝滿的靈魂瓶可以用來合成對應生物的$(l:basics/resource_crops)資源作物$().

en: The Soulium Dagger is used to collect souls from mobs. These souls are collected using $(l:souls/soul_jars)Soul Jars$(). Souls are collected by killing mobs with the Soulium Dagger $(br2)The Soulium Dagger can be upgraded using an $(l:basics/infusion_altar)Infusion Altar$(), improving soul collection efficiency.

after: 離魂匕首用來從生物身上收集靈魂。這些靈魂用$(l:souls/soul_jars)靈魂瓶$()來收集。靈魂是透過用離魂匕首擊殺生物來收集的。$(br2)離魂匕首可以使用$(l:basics/infusion_altar)注魔祭壇$()升級，提升靈魂收集效率。

en: Soulium Ore $(bold)usually$() spawns inside $(l:souls/soulstone)Soulstone$() veins in the Nether.

en: Soulstone is a special kind of stone that spawns in the Nether. It generates in large veins at all Y levels. $(br2)Soulstone is a decorative block with many variants. It is also required to create $(l:souls/witherproof_blocks)Witherproof Blocks$().
before: 離魂石是一種生成在下界的特殊的石頭. 它會在任意Y值生成大型礦脈. $(br2)離魂石是一種有多個變種的裝飾方塊. 它也被用來合成$(l:souls/witherproof_blocks)防凋零方塊$().

en:
I have designed a mining device I am calling the Arcane Bore. Once placed and given a redstone signal it will start digging out an area in front of it. The device requires a pickaxe to be placed inside it. Normally inanimate objects cannot use foci, but with a liberal application of sympathetic magic the focus could be 'tricked' into working.
This had a unforeseen benefit as well - the pickaxe is actually being used to dig on metaphysical level and any attributes and enchantments it has are actually applied to the digging process. The pickaxe will wear out however, but much slower than normal - I estimate an average pickaxe will last about 50 times longer.
The size of the area dug is also determined by the material of the pickaxe. The more enchantable the material is, the more efficient the sympathetic magic is, which in turn increases the area that can be dug.
Any blocks dug are ejected at the position of the bore. If there is an inventory adjacent to the bore the items will be placed in there instead.The bore also requires vis to function consuming 1 vis for every 4 blocks dug.The bore can be turned to face any direction except down. To change the direction it faces simply left-click on it to make it face towards you.
Like other arcane turrets the bore will also respond to arcane activator rails - passing over an inactive rail will switch it on while an active one will disable it. A bore placed directly onto a rail mounts itself as a turret so that a minecart can carry it.
To pick the bore back up, in either form, simply sneak and right-click on it.
before:
我成功造出了被我稱爲奧術鑽探機的挖掘設備，一旦被放置並且給予一個紅石信號，它會開始挖掘它面朝方向可挖掘的方塊。需要給這個設備提供一把鎬子用於挖掘。通常來說，無生命的物體無法操控核心，但通過大量運用交感魔法，可以“欺騙”核心使其生效。
這有着我未曾預料到的優點——鎬子實際上是在形而上學層面挖掘，鎬子上的附魔效果也被加成到鑽探機上。雖然鎬子還是會有損耗，但是比常規使用時損耗小得多——我估計這損耗速度比原有的慢50倍
鎬子的材質還決定着鑽探機的挖掘範圍。附魔親和性越好的材質，挖掘範圍越大。
挖掘到的方塊都會從鑽探機的孔裏噴出。如果有臨近的箱子則會自動放入其中。奧術鑽探機消耗魔力來工作，每挖掘4個方塊消耗1 vis。奧術鑽探機可以被調整至除了向下以外的任何方向。只需左擊鑽探機，就可以讓它朝向你。
就和其他奧術塔防物件一樣，鑽探機也會對奧術激活軌道有所反應——經過未激活的鐵軌會將其開啓，而經過激活的鐵軌則會將其關閉。
why: 譯文漏譯最後兩段（鐵軌上裝載為砲台、蹲下右鍵收回）；名稱與標題「奧術鑽掘機」不一致；「vis」未翻；「激活」為大陸用語；「50倍慢」與英文「久50倍」不符。
sonnet_fix:

這有着我未曾預料到的優點——鎬子實際上是在形而上學層面挖掘，鎬子上的所有屬性與附魔效果也都會作用在挖掘過程上。雖然鎬子還是會有損耗，但是比常規使用時損耗小得多——我估計一把普通鎬子的使用壽命約為原本的50倍。
挖掘區域的大小同樣取決於鎬子的材質。附魔親和性越好的材質，交感魔法就越有效率，可挖掘的範圍也就越大。

挖掘到的方塊都會在鑽掘機的位置彈出。如果鑽掘機旁邊有容器，物品則會自動放入其中。奧術鑽掘機需要消耗魔力才能運作，每挖掘4個方塊消耗1點魔力。奧術鑽掘機可以朝向除了下方以外的任何方向。若要改變朝向，只需左鍵點擊它，就可以讓它朝向你。
就和其他奧術砲台一樣，鑽掘機也會對奧術觸發鐵軌有所反應——經過未啟動的鐵軌會將其開啟，而經過已啟動的鐵軌則會將其關閉。直接放在鐵軌上的鑽掘機會自行裝載成砲台，讓礦車可以載運它。
若要收回鑽掘機（無論是哪種形態），只需蹲下並右鍵點擊它。

This mystical lamp can be attached to walls, floors or ceilings and will provide strong and steady light.
Additional sources of light may also appear up to 16 blocks away wherever light levels fall below accepted 'safe' levels. Remember: Only YOU can prevent zombie outbreaks.
These secondary sources of light will disappear soon after the lamp has been removed.
The lamp can be turned off by applying a redstone signal.
When placed against an arcane bore, the arcane lamp gains an additional ability: It will light up the tunnel that the bore digs.

It will search the inventory above it for components and try to combine whatever it finds in the pattern you have selected. If this results in a valid crafting operation it will place the result in the container below it.
You can change the pattern by clicking on the brass dial on the front of the device.
A redstone signal will disable the device.Each crafting operation will drain 1 vis from the aura.

en:
I set out to improve thaumium armor and I think I have outdone myself. I have drawn up designs for a suit of armor of exceptional craftsmanship, durability and strength. I am calling it Thaumium Fortress Armor.
Each individual piece of Thaumium Fortress armor has the same protective properties as diamond armor, but has greater durability and offers additional protection against magic and fire.
The biggest benefit however is that the individual armor pieces are designed and constructed to be worn together: Each additional piece of this armor worn increases the overall protection offered by all other pieces and improves its visual appeal.
As with most objects constructed from thaumium, the armor is easy to enchant.

en:
Every item, object or creature is bound by varying mystical elements known as §5aspects§0. Aspects describe the object's makeup and bent towards the magical elements. A simple stone may possess the aspect of Terra while more complex items like trees or even creatures can be made up of various different aspects in varying amounts. There are dozens of known aspects with more being discovered all the time.There are two main types of aspects: §5Primal§0 and §5Compound§0.§lPrimal Aspects§r are the most basic types of aspects and there are only 6 of them: §6Aer§0 (air), §2Terra§0 (earth), §cIgnis§0 (fire), §3Aqua§0 (water), §7Ordo§0 (order), §8Perditio§0 (entropy).
These form the basic building blocks of all other aspects.
§lCompound Aspects§r are built from two other aspects. The simplest compound aspects are made from two primal aspects, but it is possible to have incredibly complex compound aspects made from successive layers of simpler aspects.
The simplest example of such a compound aspect is the aspect of Victus (life), which is a combination of §2Terra§0 and §3Aqua§0.To view what aspects an item possesses, simply hover your cursor over the item and press sneak (shift), and you will see what aspects that item has and what amounts of each. You will first need to study the item however, until then the aspects will remain unknown.Aspects that have somehow been separated from their object and purified are known as §5Essentia§0 - a magical liquid that is both a valuable crafting ingredient and a subject for magical research.
before:
每件物品、物體或生物都由各種被稱作§5要素§0的神祕元素所束縛。要素描述着物體的構成及其對魔法元素的傾向。一塊簡單的石頭可能只擁有地要素，而樹木乃至生物這樣更復雜的物體，則可能由多種數量各異的要素構成。已知的要素有數十種，而且還在不斷被髮掘。要素主要分爲兩類：§5原初要素§0與§5複合要素§0。§l原初要素§r是最基本的要素類型，一共只有6種：§6風§0、§2地§0、§c火§0、§3水§0、§7秩序§0、§8混沌§0。
它們是所有其他要素的基本構成單元。
§l複合要素§r由另外兩種要素構成。最簡單的複合要素由兩種原初要素組成，但也有可能通過一層層更簡單的要素，組合出極其複雜的複合要素。
這類複合要素最簡單的例子便是生命要素，它由§2地§0和§3水§0組合而成。要查看一件物品擁有哪些要素，只需將光標懸停在物品上並按下潛行（shift）鍵，你便能看到該物品擁有哪些要素以及各自的數量。不過你需要先研究該物品，在此之前要素將一直保持未知。以某種方式與物體分離並得到純化的要素，被稱作§5源質§0——一種魔法液體，既是寶貴的合成原料，也是魔法研究的對象。

en:
Crucible crafting guide
1) Place crucible over heat source (fire, lava, nitor or something similar).
2) Add water and wait till it boils.
3) Add ingredients with the essentia you require, either by dropping them in or clicking with the item on the crucible's top face
4) Throw in catalyst.Things to note
- Shift-right clicking with an empty hand will empty a crucible.
- Each crafting operation will consume some of the water so I will have to replenish it now and again. Piping mechanics can be used for this.
- I can craft multiple items at once by adding sufficient essentia and using multiple catalysts.
- Essentia does dissolve over time so I shouldn't wait too long before starting to craft. I wonder what the purple puffs of smoke means when this happens? Probably nothing to worry about.§oCrafting Crystals§r
Essentia crystals should be fairly easy to craft. All I need to do is break down a quartz crystal into smaller shards to act as a growth medium.
Simply dipping a shard into the crucible should soak up some of the essentia it contains and cause the crystal to grow.
This won't be a particularly efficient way of doing things - it will probably cost at least twice the essentia that the crystal will end up containing and there is the net loss of quartz which is not always the easiest thing to find.
before:
坩堝煉金指南
1） 將坩堝放在熱源之上（火，岩漿，閃耀之光或者其它類似的東西）。
2） 加入水並等待其沸騰。
3） 加入含有所需源質的配料，你可以直接丟進坩堝或者用配料右擊坩堝的頂面。
4） 投入觸媒。注意事項
- 空手按住shift右鍵可以清空坩堝
- 每次煉金操作都會消耗一些水，所以我不得不再次補充它。可以使用管道機械來做到這一點。
- 我可以通過加入足夠的源質再加入多個觸媒來一次性煉成多個物品。
- 源質會隨着時間消失，所以我不能在煉金時發呆太久。我很疑惑，這種情況下升起的紫色煙霧意味着什麼？也許沒什麼可擔心的。§o結晶煉成§r
源質結晶應該很容易煉成。我需要做的就是將石英晶體分解成更小的碎片來充當晶核。
只要將一塊碎片浸入坩堝，它就會吸收源質，併成長爲結晶。
這並不是一種高效的方式——它會消耗雙倍的源質，還會損耗石英這種不怎麼容易找到的資源。我也不能精確控制哪些源質產生結晶。

en:
I have everything I need. All I need to do is craft my first focus.
By arranging specially prepared vis crystals around the blank focus I can set up patterns that will determine what function the focus will perform. For now I only know the patterns for §nRoot§0, §nTouch§0 and §nFire§0.
The §nRoot§0 node represents me, the caster. In the focal manipulator interface it is shown as an eye icon. The empty node below it is marked with both a target and a trajectory icon. Mediums (like §nTouch§0) require trajectories to determine what they effect - the §nRoot§0 node provides a trajectory that matches where the caster is looking so by linking §nTouch§0 to it I will be able to 'touch' anything I am looking at. Mediums almost always provide a target (in this case whatever has been 'touched') and some can also provide a trajectory. In this case though I require a target so I will be able to link the §nFire§0 effect.
By linking §nRoot§0, §nTouch§0 and §nFire§0 in this way I will be able to create a focus that applies the §nFire§0 effect to whatever I touch.
I could in theory link §nFire§0 directly to §nRoot§0, but since root provides the caster as a target that means I will simply set myself on fire.
I can fine tune exactly what the §nFire§0 effect does by tweaking its damage and burn duration in the bottom right of the interface. Many patterns will allow me to fine tune them in this way.
Creating a focus require three types of resources - the first is the crystals used in the crafting process, the second is vis from the aura, and lastly it also requires some player experience. Every time a focus is used it will also consume a small amount of vis from the aura.§nComplexity§0
The effects I can create now are fairly simple and limited. There is a limit to how many patterns I can attach to a focus. This is measured as the focus Complexity. Each pattern type has a complexity cost and increasing their paramaters (for example the damage of a fire pattern) will increase the complexity further. Using a pattern more than once also incurs a stacking complexity cost increase of 50%.
The complexity of a focus directly determines how much vis it will cost to cast and how long my wand needs to cool down between casts.
before:
我已經萬事俱備，只需製作我的第一個核心。
通過在空白核心周圍擺放特製的魔力水晶，我可以設定圖案，從而決定該核心將執行何種功能。目前我只掌握§n根源§0、§n觸碰§0和§n火焰§0三種圖案。
§n根源§0節點代表我自己，也就是施法者。在核心鑲飾台的界面中，它以眼睛圖標顯示。其下方空着的節點同時標有目標與彈道圖標。媒介（比如§n觸碰§0）需要彈道來確定其作用對象——§n根源§0節點提供的彈道與施法者的視線方向一致，因此把§n觸碰§0連接到它上面，我就能“觸碰”到所注視的任何東西。媒介幾乎總會提供一個目標（在這裏就是被“觸碰”到的對象），有些也能提供彈道。而此刻我需要一個目標，才能接上§n火焰§0效果。
以這種方式連接§n根源§0、§n觸碰§0與§n火焰§0，我就能製作出一個把§n火焰§0效果施加到我觸碰對象上的核心。
理論上我也可以把§n火焰§0直接連到§n根源§0上，但由於根源會把我這個施法者當作目標，那樣我就只會引火燒身。
我可以在界面右下角微調§n火焰§0效果的傷害和燃燒時間，從而精確調整它的作用。許多圖案都允許這樣微調。
製作核心需要三種資源——首先是合成過程中用到的水晶，其次是靈氣中的魔力，最後還需要一些玩家經驗。每次使用核心時，也會消耗靈氣中的少量魔力。§n複雜度§0
我現在能創造的效果相當簡單而有限。一個核心所能附加的圖案數量是有限制的，這以核心的複雜度來衡量。每種圖案都有複雜度消耗，提高它們的參數（例如火焰圖案的傷害）會進一步增加複雜度。重複使用同一圖案也會帶來50%的疊加複雜度增長。
核心的複雜度直接決定了它每次施法的魔力消耗，以及法杖兩次施法之間所需的冷卻時間。
why: 「界面」「圖標」為大陸用語，台灣作「介面」「圖示」。

§n根源§0節點代表我自己，也就是施法者。在核心鑲飾台的介面中，它以眼睛圖示顯示。其下方空着的節點同時標有目標與彈道圖示。媒介（比如§n觸碰§0）需要彈道來確定其作用對象——§n根源§0節點提供的彈道與施法者的視線方向一致，因此把§n觸碰§0連接到它上面，我就能“觸碰”到所注視的任何東西。媒介幾乎總會提供一個目標（在這裏就是被“觸碰”到的對象），有些也能提供彈道。而此刻我需要一個目標，才能接上§n火焰§0效果。
以這種方式連接§n根源§0、§n觸碰§0與§n火焰§0，我就能製作出一個把§n火焰§0效果施加到我觸碰對象上的核心。
理論上我也可以把§n火焰§0直接連到§n根源§0上，但由於根源會把我這個施法者當作目標，那樣我就只會引火燒身。
我可以在介面右下角微調§n火焰§0效果的傷害和燃燒時間，從而精確調整它的作用。許多圖案都允許這樣微調。
製作核心需要三種資源——首先是合成過程中用到的水晶，其次是靈氣中的魔力，最後還需要一些玩家經驗。每次使用核心時，也會消耗靈氣中的少量魔力。§n複雜度§0
我現在能創造的效果相當簡單而有限。一個核心所能附加的圖案數量是有限制的，這以核心的複雜度來衡量。每種圖案都有複雜度消耗，提高它們的參數（例如火焰圖案的傷害）會進一步增加複雜度。重複使用同一圖案也會帶來50%的疊加複雜度增長。
核心的複雜度直接決定了它每次施法的魔力消耗，以及法杖兩次施法之間所需的冷卻時間。

en:
My hand shakes as I write this. The strange substance I have investigated has opened strange new vistas in my mind.
Before me I have formulas for creating a mysterious new metal, yet I do not remember writing them, nor does the handwriting look quite like mine.
The metal they describe is a mass of contradictions. It is hard and unyielding, yet at the same time soft and easy to work. It will feel warm to the touch, almost alive and like living things it will slowly heal itself if damaged.
Crafting mere physical tools from this seems almost... wrong.
before:
我顫抖着雙手記錄下這一切。我研究的奇怪物質在腦海中展開了一片從未見過的奇異景象。
在我面前是一個神祕的新金屬的創造公式，但是我不記得寫了這個公式，這筆跡也不像是我的。
他們描述的這個金屬矛盾百出。既堅硬且難以彎折，又柔軟且容易加工。它觸摸起來會感覺到溫暖，就像活的生物一樣，如果損壞，它會慢慢自我治癒。
用這種實驗來創造出純粹的物理工具似乎…不太可行。

en:
I have found a way to give a crossbow a mind of its own, turning it into a simple automated turret.
When placed in the world it will automatically fire at any hostile monsters it detects within range. Unfortunately its limited mind does not allow me to fine tune its targets.
It has a very limited internal inventory, but if I place it over an upward facing dispenser it will automatically reload itself from that inventory.
Right clicking on it while sneaking will pick it up.The turret can ride in a minecart and will reload from a dispenser placed underneath the track.
Passing over an arcane activator rail will change the behaviour of the turret. If the rail is active it will disable the turret. Passing over an inactive rail will enable it again.

放置好後的自動十字弩會自動朝着射程內的所有敵對生物開火。不幸的是它有限的思維能力不允許我爲其精細地設置攻擊目標。
它內部存儲空間也非常有限，但我可以將其放置在一個面朝上的發射器上，這樣它就能夠自動從發射器中裝填彈藥了。

Stoking furnaces with a bellows increases their heat and smelting speed, but pumping air by hand seems like a crazy waste of my time and talent. Now, if the bellows were able to pump itself that would be a different matter entirely.

en:
I have designed a pair of enchanted boots that will ease the journey of any traveler.
They will allow one to move faster, jump higher and fall further.
Lastly they allow you to cut through water like a fish. A slow and clumsy fish, but a fish nonetheless.
This power does have a cost however - the boots need to be charged with vis for their abilities to function.

這雙富含神祕的魔力工藝技巧的靴子能讓任何旅行者的旅途變得更輕鬆愉快。

另外，它還能讓你像魚一樣破浪而行，雖然是一條相對緩慢和笨拙的魚，可也算條魚嘛！
然而，這雙鞋需要吸取周圍的靈氣來發揮功效。

en:
A simple chamberstick of alchemical brass. Right-click it with any tallow candle to seat the candle, and right-click it with an empty hand to take the candle back.
A holder bearing a candle steadies an infusion exactly like the candle it holds: mirrored pairs must match in both holder metal and candle colour.
Placed on top of a research table, a lit holder calms the mind: whenever you write or combine an aspect there is a 5%% chance that it is not consumed. A holder on each half of the table adds its chance to the other.

en:
Thaumium is known for its ability to store and absorb magic, so using it to craft wand caps is a logical choice. It is very efficient at focusing vis of all types.
Crafting these wand caps in an arcane workbench is not sufficient - they need to be infused with additional magical energy to make them usable.

The alchemical centrifuge is a wondrous invention that allows me to break essentia into its component parts.
When compound essentia flows into the centrifuge from below it will be slowly broken down into the primal or compound essentia that it is made from. Only one of the components is created for each point of essentia broken down.
The resulting essentia needs to be drawn from the top of the centrifuge. Because of the idiosyncrasies of the tube pressure system, it would be best to connect an Essentia Buffer to the top of the centrifuge.

en:
Golems cannot do anything they are not told to do. For this purpose I have created Control Seals. You can place these circular clay seals against almost any surface you wish. Once you do they will become become ethereal and intangible, but you will still be able to see them as long as you hold a golem, another seal or §5Golemancer's Bell§0.
The bell will be an important tool as you will use it to fine tune the settings and parameters of the command seals.
Since seals are ethereal you can place down another block in the same spot as you placed a seal.
Several seals can also occupy the same block space as long as the are located on different faces of a block. This should allow you to keep things quite compact.
You can retrieve a seal by holding shift and right-clicking on it with the bell.Clicking on a seal with the bell will allow you to tweak its parameters. The exact parameters will vary from seal to seal, but most seals will allow you to give them a priority between -5 and +5 (default 0). Tasks created by higher priority seals will be performed first. You will also be able to see a list of required traits that a golem will need to have in order to perform tasks created by that seal.
For example, a seal might require a golem to have the §5Deft§0 trait, or perhaps another seal will require that a golem NOT have the §5Clumsy§0 trait.
For a practical example, look at the §5Collect Seal§0.Seals can be set to become inactive when they recieve a redstone signal. All queued or in progress tasks from that seal will also be removed.
It is also possible to assign a color to a seal. If you do so tasks from that seal will only be performed by uncolored golems or golems with the same color. Uncolored seals will assign tasks to all golems (colored and uncolored alike).
You set seal colors in the same location where you set priorities.
You assign a golem a color by using a dye on it. The color will be cleared if the golem is picked up.
before:
傀儡無法在沒有收到指示的情況下進行任何工作。爲此，我製作出了傀儡控制印記。你可以將這枚印記貼在任何表面上。一旦你這樣做了，粘貼完成的傀儡印記會變得縹緲無形。不過，當你手持任意種類的傀儡，控制印記或是§5傀儡師鈴鐺§0時，之前粘貼的控制印記會被一併顯示出來。
傀儡師鈴鐺是用於印記設定內容調整的重要工具。
由於印記是虛無縹緲的，你可以在相同的位置放置任何其他方塊。
可以將不同印記放置在同一方塊的不同表面。這有助於你節省空間。
手持傀儡師鈴鐺按住潛行鍵右擊即可取下印記。手持傀儡師鈴鐺直接右擊印記可以修改印記的相關設置。不同類型印記的設置內容有所不同，不過絕大多數印記支持在-5到+5之間調整其優先級（默認是0）。由高優先級印記發出的指令會被傀儡優先執行。你還能看到該印記對於執行其指令的傀儡的特性要求。
例如，部分印記要求傀儡具有§5靈巧§0特性，並且要求傀儡不能帶有§5笨拙§0特性。
具體例子請參見§5控制印記：聚集§0。當印記接收到紅石信號時會停止工作，而傀儡正在進行的工作也會被取消。
你也能爲印記指定顏色。指定顏色後，印記的任務將會只被無色或者同色的傀儡執行。沒有顏色的印記會把任務指派給所有傀儡（不論染色與否）。
設定顏色的地方和設定優先級的地方相同。
通過對傀儡使用染料來指定其顏色。收回傀儡會清除其顏色。

en:
As I expected it was not hard to expand on the workings of the thaumometer to design the Thaumic Dioptra.
This device allows a thaumaturge to see the surrounding aura in a simple and clear manner. It will render the aura in a 13 chunk diameter area around it as a simple height map. It can also be switched to show flux instead by simply clicking on it.
A comparator can be connected if you want to monitor the aura or flux level of the chunk in which it is placed.
before:
對於我這樣的神祕使來說，做出這臺設備簡直輕而易舉。
這臺複雜的設備能夠讓神祕使以一種簡單而明晰的方式察看周圍的靈氣。能夠渲染出直徑爲13個區塊範圍內的靈氣分佈視圖。它也會顯示出靈氣中的咒波——污染程度越大，紫色越深。
在側面放置紅石比較器可以得知其所在區塊的靈氣濃度等級。

不出所料，在秘術觀測鏡的原理上加以擴展，要設計出秘術經緯儀並不困難。

en:
With the discovery of infusion, I should experiment with binding primal elements into tools and weapons. If I am correct this will grant them unique and powerful properties.
For my initial experiments I should stick to working with thaumium tools - they will be easy to infuse and will be a good base for future experiments.
before:
發現注魔的原理後，我找到將原初要素融入工具和武器中的方法。這樣製做出的每種設備都擁有獨特和強大的特性。
在我最初的設想中，神祕工具是完美的實驗材料——它們具有極高的魔力親和性，這將爲之後的實驗打下良好的基礎。
why: 原文是「應該嘗試」，譯文寫成已找到方法；「製做」錯字，且 thaumium tools 與易於注魔的語意未對上。
sonnet_fix:
發現注魔的原理後，我應該嘗試把原初要素融入工具和武器中。如果我的推斷正確，這會賦予它們獨特而強大的特性。
在最初的實驗中，我應當專注於神祕金屬工具——它們容易注魔，也將爲之後的實驗打下良好的基礎。

en:
I have drawn up the required rites to infuse the thaumium tools I have created. If my calculations are correct they will have some unique and interesting abilities.§oAxe of the Stream§r
By combining water shards and a thaumium axe, I have designed a tool that embodies the aspects of motion and flow.
It functions like a normal axe on all materials except natural logs and trees. When used on them the axe seeks to furthest block of the same type that is still connected to the block you are attempting to harvest and harvests that one instead.
In effect you will chop trees from the top down even if you hit the bottom-most block.
Any wood chopped in this fashion will automatically float towards you.
If you press and hold right click the axe will draw all nearby items towards you - not just wood it chopped.
If shift is held while using this tool all its special properties are suspended and it functions like a normal axe.§oPickaxe of the Core§r
By infusing a thaumium pickaxe with fire shards, I have designed a pickaxe that glows with the heat of a forge.
When you mine ore blocks there is a chance that you will mine a cluster instead. Native clusters are much easier to process and produces double the normal amount of metal when smelted.
It can also be used to sound out any surface you right click against to find out what valuable ores can be found nearby.
If shift is held while using this tool all its special properties are suspended and it functions like a normal pickaxe.§oSword of the Zephyr§r
I have merged the elemental fury of air shards with a thaumium sword.
When used to strike a foe, the blade will sweep in a wide arc, hitting additional foes near your main target.
While blocking the sword will conjure a sphere of whirling winds around you, pushing enemies and loose objects away and deflecting incoming projectiles.
While blocking it will also slowly lift you into the air.§oShovel of the Earthmover§r
Combining earth shards with a thaumium shovel I have designed a peerless digging implement.
When used to dig earth, sand and similar materials it will dig a 3x3 area.
If you right click on the side of a block, it will attempt to place a 3x3 section of the same material in the world as long as you have sufficient blocks in my inventory.
The orientation of both the digging and construction depends on the face you dug or clicked.
If shift is pressed you can see where blocks will be placed in the world and you can change the orientation of how blocks are placed by pressing 'G' on the keyboard. Blocks can be placed either parallel to the block face selected, or extending out of the face vertically or horizontally.
If shift is held while using this tool it will no longer dig in a 3x3 pattern.§oHoe of Growth§r
By merging the magical energy from order and entropy shards with a thaumium hoe, I have created a farming implement with few equals.
When used to till fields, it will till a 3x3 area instead of just a single block.
When used to crops or other plants it will act as bonemeal to promote its growth, though at a higher cost to its durability. It might even be able to grow plants that normal bonemeal can't.
If shift is held while using this tool all its special properties are suspended and it functions like a normal hoe.§oSpear of the Firmament§r
I have bound air shards to a thaumium spear, and the result feeds on momentum rather than muscle.
Braced and driven home at speed it vents that momentum into whatever it pierces, hurling the creature skyward. The faster the charge, the higher they fly, and everything caught along the shaft rises with it.
If shift is held while using this weapon all its special properties are suspended and it functions like a normal spear.
before:
我草擬了一份注魔配方表，如果計算沒有失誤的話它們將擁有獨特和強大的特性。§o奔流斧§r
將水之碎片與神祕錠製作的斧融合，我打造出一柄擁有流水特性的魔斧。
這把斧頭除了對木材和原木使用外，與普通斧頭相比無甚特殊之處。當用它來採伐木頭的時候，它會首先將與這個方塊相連最遠的方塊採掘並吸收過來。
因此你可以用這柄斧頭砍掉整顆樹，即使你敲擊的是樹幹最低端的位置。
如此砍下的原木都會自動地流向你。
而按住右鍵時，附近所有的可拾取物品，包括但不限於你砍伐的木頭，都會自動流向你。
當你按住潛行鍵則可以抑制其特效，將其作爲普通斧頭使用。§o熾心鎬§r
將火之碎片與神祕錠製作的鎬融合，你打造出一柄冒着熊熊火光的魔鎬。
使用熾心鎬採掘礦物時有一定幾率掉落原礦簇而非礦石。冶煉原礦簇能得到雙倍的產出。
持有熾心鎬右擊任意方塊表面，能夠探測並顯示最近的礦物。
按住潛行則可以抑制其特效，將其作爲普通鎬子使用。§o風雷劍§r
將風之碎片與神祕錠製作的劍融合，你打造出一柄蘊含風雷之力的魔劍。
用這柄魔劍攻擊敵人時可以觸發連鎖閃電特性，彈射的電弧將會波及次要目標。
右鍵使用的時候則會召喚出一道纏繞你自身的旋風，將你的敵人以及任何實體目標吹開。
使用時持有者也會緩慢騰昇至空中。§o后土鍬§r
將地之碎片與神祕錠製作的鍬融合，你打造出一柄洋溢着大地氣息的魔鍬。
當你用來它挖掘沙子，泥土以及類似物品的時候能夠一次性挖掘3x3範圍內的相同方塊。
如果你右擊某方塊時，它會試圖放置3x3的相同方塊。當然你的物品欄中必須有足夠的同種方塊。
它的挖掘和放置方向取決於你所挖或點擊的面。
按下潛行鍵你可以看到方塊將在何處被放置，按下G鍵以調整方塊放置的方向。方塊可以被平行放置在所選位置之上，也可以垂直或者是水平伸出。
當你按住潛行則可以抑制其特效，將其作爲普通鍬使用。§o句芒鋤§r
將秩序碎片與神祕錠製作的鋤融合，你打造出一柄農業方面近乎全能的鋤頭。
使用它可以一次開墾3x3的田地而不像普通鋤頭那樣一次只能開墾一塊地。
手持句芒鋤對作物或者其他植物右鍵，將發揮類似使用骨粉的效果，儘管這種功能會更快消耗其耐久。即使對一些普通骨粉不能催化的植物句芒鋤也可能能夠進行催發。
當你按住潛行則可以抑制其特效，將其作爲普通鋤頭使用。§o蒼穹矛§r
將風之碎片與神祕錠製作的長矛融合，我打造出一柄駕馭動量而非蠻力的魔矛。
當持矛衝刺並刺中目標時，長矛會將積累的動能盡數灌注於貫穿之物，猛然將生物拋向高空。衝刺速度越快，拋飛得越高，並且被矛杆掃中的所有東西都會一同升空。
按住潛行則可以抑制其特效，將其作爲普通長矛使用。
why: 風之劍段落是舊版殘稿（連鎖閃電、右鍵召喚旋風，與原文的橫掃、格擋偏轉投射物對不上）；鋤段落漏譯 entropy 碎片。

將火之碎片與神祕錠製作的鎬融合，你打造出一柄冒着熊熊火光的魔鎬。
使用熾心鎬採掘礦物時有一定機率掉落原礦簇而非礦石。冶煉原礦簇能得到雙倍的產出。
持有熾心鎬右擊任意方塊表面，能夠探測並顯示最近的礦物。
按住潛行則可以抑制其特效，將其作爲普通鎬子使用。§o西風劍§r
我將風之碎片的元素之怒與神祕錠製作的劍融合。
用這柄劍攻擊敵人時，劍刃會掃出一道寬闊的弧線，波及主要目標附近的其他敵人。
格擋時，這柄劍會在你周身召來一團旋風，將敵人與散落的物品推開，並偏轉來襲的投射物。
格擋時也會讓你緩緩升向空中。§o后土鍬§r
將地之碎片與神祕錠製作的鍬融合，你打造出一柄洋溢着大地氣息的魔鍬。
當你用來它挖掘沙子，泥土以及類似物品的時候能夠一次性挖掘3x3範圍內的相同方塊。
如果你右擊某方塊時，它會試圖放置3x3的相同方塊。當然你的物品欄中必須有足夠的同種方塊。
它的挖掘和放置方向取決於你所挖或點擊的面。
按下潛行鍵你可以看到方塊將在何處被放置，按下G鍵以調整方塊放置的方向。方塊可以被平行放置在所選位置之上，也可以垂直或者是水平伸出。
當你按住潛行則可以抑制其特效，將其作爲普通鍬使用。§o句芒鋤§r
將秩序與混沌碎片所蘊含的魔法能量與神祕錠製作的鋤融合，你打造出一柄農業方面近乎全能的鋤頭。
使用它可以一次開墾3x3的田地而不像普通鋤頭那樣一次只能開墾一塊地。
手持句芒鋤對作物或者其他植物右鍵，將發揮類似使用骨粉的效果，儘管這種功能會更快消耗其耐久。即使對一些普通骨粉不能催化的植物句芒鋤也可能能夠進行催發。
當你按住潛行則可以抑制其特效，將其作爲普通鋤頭使用。§o蒼穹矛§r
將風之碎片與神祕錠製作的長矛融合，我打造出一柄駕馭動量而非蠻力的魔矛。
當持矛衝刺並刺中目標時，長矛會將積累的動能盡數灌注於貫穿之物，猛然將生物拋向高空。衝刺速度越快，拋飛得越高，並且被矛杆掃中的所有東西都會一同升空。
按住潛行則可以抑制其特效，將其作爲普通長矛使用。

en:

The essentia crystallizer draws in liquid essentia from a pipe network and slowly converts it into small shards of crystalline essentia. Crystalline essentia is safe to handle and very stable.
The Crystallizer either ejects the crystals into the world or into a container. It can be disabled with a redstone signal.
Supplying it with vis will greatly increase its speed.

Most types of essentia are fairly volatile and care must be taken in their storage - that is why most thaumaturges use warded jars. I, however, am not most thaumaturges.
Using the wonderful new substance called void metal, I have discovered a way to greatly improve the storage of essentia. Essentia reservoirs are capable of storing up to 256 essentia in any combination.
Potentially disastrous mixing of the different essentia types is prevented by dynamically reshaping compartments crafted from the new metal.

en:
Thaumium has proven to be a good choice, though not quite as effective as I had hoped.
The Thaumium Smeltery works much like the basic smeltery, but it has roughly 90% efficiency instead of 80%. Not nearly the improvement I was hoping for, but better than nothing I suppose.
Its main benefit is that it breaks down essentia slurry at double the normal speed.

它最大的好處是，分解速度達到了原來的兩倍。

I need to go back to the drawing board. Using Thaumium did improve the smelting process, but not to the degree I had hoped.
My recent discovery of Void Metal has opened up a new avenue of research for me. It is much more resilient and malleable than Thaumium. I should put it through the same battery of tests I did for Thaumium and see how the two compare.
It might also be worth changing the internal plumbing to incorporate Void Metal in some manner.

en:
I have cracked the method of keeping aerated essentia stable outside of infusion.
I have drawn up plans for two devices. The Filling Essentia Transfuser can take essentia directly from a pipe network or other essentia source and transport it to jars within 16 blocks of the direction it is facing.
The Emptying Essentia Transfuser does the opposite - drawing essentia from jars within range and placing it within tubes or devices requiring essentia of a specific type.

源質注入裝置則正好相反——從附近的源質罐子內抽取源質並輸送至其所依附的管道系統或具有源質需求設備中。

en:
Shimmerleaf is often overshadowed by its mystical neighbor the Silverwood tree, but it has magical properties of its own.
Like the Silverwood, Shimmerleaf flowers have purifying properties that lie dormant. I have found a way to awaken these properties and turn it into an §lEthereal Bloom§r.
Ethereal blooms slowly, but surely, restore land corrupted by mystical means to its former glory - this includes the blight known as Taint. While they cannot combat Taint directly, few tainted growths can survive outside their native environment for long and tend to die back.The flower only purifies the land bathed in its light out to a range of about 8 blocks.

水銀花常常生長在銀樹附近的陰影之中，但是它亦有自己獨特的魔法屬性。

天域花，能夠十分緩慢但確定無疑地恢復這片被神祕力量（包括我們通常稱之爲腐化的咒波污染）所污染和破壞的大地，使其重回昔日的榮光之下。雖然它並不能夠直接對抗腐化，但腐化的植物會很難蔓延到天域花所處的環境中，並會漸漸趨向於枯萎死亡。這種花只能淨化其光芒所及之處，範圍約 8 格。

en:
A small fountain of pure water always flows from the top of this urn, making it a perfect water source to fill my buckets, bottles or other liquid containers.
The urn will also automatically replenish any liquid containers within two blocks of it if they can accept water from the top. This is perfect for automatically refilling crucibles, but has other uses as well.
Fluid pipes can be attached to the top of the urn for more mundane uses.
Every bucket full of water created costs 1 vis which is drawn directly from the aura.
The water does taste a bit... odd. Nothing to worry about I'm sure.
before:
從甕口不斷湧出的一小股清泉讓無盡之甕能夠用來爲水桶，藥瓶和其他流體容器提供水源。
它還能夠爲兩格範圍內的流體容器自動添水，只要這些容器能夠從頂部注水。配合坩堝可以很完美地實現自動化，當然別的方面也有諸多妙用。
流體管道可以接在甕的頂部以便作爲其它更凡庸的方法使用。
每製造一桶水都會從靈氣中抽取1點Vis。
水的味道有點…奇怪。我確定無需擔心。

en:
I see a time fast approaching where I will need to have ready access to multiple different kinds of essentia. For that I will need a source and the most obvious is the essentia found in, well, everything.
Using alchemical principles, I should be able to find a way to break down objects and convert them into essentia. Before I can start however I will need to study essentia in the purest form available to me - vis crystals.
By subjecting these crystals to, um, "destructive testing" I should be able to determine how they react in various extremes and the best way to preserve their purity.
I should start with primal Essentia.
before:
看來在不遠的將來，我需要準備好各種不同的源質。爲此，我需要找些原料，顯然能從中找到源質的原料是…嗯，任何東西都行。
使用煉金術原則應該能夠找到一種分解物體並將其轉化爲源質的方法。 然而，在我開始之前，我需要研究以最純粹的形式存在的源質 —— 源質結晶。

我應該先從基礎源質入手。

en:
Such strange wonders are being revealed to me. Peering through the lens of the Thaumometer shows me a world coursing with magic, Vis as the books calls it.
Normally this energy is a pure ocean of magic that ebbs and flows, but it also permeates all things, both animate and inanimate. The book calls Vis in this state Essentia. Where Vis is formless and pure, Essentia is more rigid in its nature and falls into a multitude of clearly defined types, each mixing together with others to form greater and more complex types of essentia.
I am not quite sure if the matter it is bound to gives Essentia its nature, or that the very nature of matter depends on the Essentia it contains. This bears further study.
I am keeping a log of all the types of essentia I discover. A bookmark on the left will show my current knowledge.
Every object and creature I examine yields research points of the aspects it contains - these points are the currency of my studies.
I have recorded everything I have learned about aspects and the process of research itself in two separate entries in this book: §5Aspects of Magic§0 and §5Research§0. I should study both before proceeding.
before:
如此奇異的景象正向我展露。透過魔導透鏡，我看到一個魔力奔湧的世界——書中稱之爲魔力（Vis）。
通常這種能量是一片純粹、漲落起伏的魔力海洋，但它也滲透於萬物之中，無論有無生命。書籍將這種狀態下的魔力稱作源質。如果說魔力無形而純粹，那麼源質則性質更爲固化，並分化成許多定義明確的類型，每種類型又彼此混合，形成更宏大、更復雜的源質類型。
我尚不確定是它所束縛的物質賦予了源質本性，還是物質的本性取決於其所含的源質。這值得進一步研究。
我把發現的所有源質類型都記錄下來。左側的書籤會展示我當前的知識。
我檢視的每件物體和生物都會產出其所含要素的研究點數——這些點數便是我研究的貨幣。
我把關於要素和研究過程的所學，分別記錄在這本書的兩個條目中：§5魔法要素§0與§5研究§0。繼續之前，我應當先研讀這兩者。
why: 「復雜」為錯字，應作「複雜」。

en:
I have been monitoring a strange buildup of magical energy in the aura. It seems to be a form of 'dirty' vis that I have named Flux. It shows as an ominous dark bar on my thaumometer.
I now know what those purple puffs are I occasionally see when I am being careless - it is essentia spilling into the atmosphere and becoming Flux. Pure essentia, it seems, should not be directly exposed to the aura.
I'm not exactly sure what negative effects this will cause, but I have noticed that Flux seems to clog the local aura preventing Vis from replenishing naturally.
Picture it as a thick layer of scum on a natural pool of clean water.
The local aura has a point at which it is 'filled' and Flux seems to count towards this capacity.
More alarmingly, it seems to take precedence over vis and I suspect it can probably exceed this natural limit.
I am not sure what will happen when Flux overflows, but it it bound to be interesting.
before:
我監測到靈氣場中存在奇異的魔法力量在聚集。它們看上去是一種“被污染”的魔力，我將它們稱爲“咒波”（Flux）。我能夠通過魔導透鏡上不詳的黑色指示條來觀察周圍的腐化。
我現在知道，當因我的粗心大意而讓一些紫色的泡沫出現 — 它們滲透到空氣當中，成爲咒波。看來，純淨的源質並不應該直接暴露在空氣當中。
我不確定它到底會帶來什麼負面影響，不過我注意到，咒波的存在堵塞了周圍的靈氣場，阻礙了魔力的自然補充。
設想它就像是一池清水上一層厚厚的淤泥。
當地的靈氣場似乎“充溢”在一個點上，而咒波也正湧向這同一個點。
更令人震驚的是，咒波的流動似乎更優先於魔力的流動，我懷疑這甚至能超越自然的極限。
我不知道當咒波溢出的時候會發生什麼，但肯定會非常有趣。
why: 第二段句子破碎，purple puffs 與 spilling 的意思被扭曲；第一段把黑色指示條說成觀察「腐化」，與原文不符；後段 filled 與 capacity 的意思也偏離。

en:
I may have made a mess of things. I have allowed flux to build up in the aura and now I need to get rid of it - fast.
Fortunately the answer might be found in one of the unique properties of flux. Technically flux is just 'dirty' vis, but what sets it apart is the fact that it can easily transform from a form of energy into physical matter. This makes it dangerous as it can spawn Taint and other forms of nastiness, but maybe it can also be coaxed into safer forms.
before:
我可能弄得一團糟了。我放任咒波在靈氣場內聚集，但現在我需要儘快擺脫它。
幸運的是，解決方法可以利用咒波的特性。從技術上說，咒波是“被污染”的魔力 。但不同的是它可以很輕易地從能量轉化爲物質。因爲可以產生污點或其它污染的特性，它變得很危險。但也許它能夠被誘導爲更安全的形式。
why: Taint 誤譯為「污點」，應為「腐化」；句意也有偏差。
sonnet_fix:
我可能弄得一團糟了。我放任咒波在靈氣場內聚集，現在需要儘快擺脫它。
幸運的是，答案或許就在咒波的獨特性質之中。從技術上說，咒波只是“被污染”的魔力，但它的特別之處在於能輕易地從能量轉化爲物質。這使它很危險，因爲它可能生成腐化和其他各種噁心的東西，但也許它也能被誘導成更安全的形式。

en:
I have managed to find a way of turn pure Flux in the aura into flux essentia. Flux essentia is hardly benign, but it is much easier to handle than raw Flux. Unfortunately the process is not simple, cheap, or fast.
I have drawn up plans for a Flux Condenser. When supplied with lots of essentia it can draw flux from the aura and force it to become essentia itself. Every point of flux drawn from the aura will require 5 or more essentia and some time. The type of essentia does not matter as long as I do not use Flux essentia. That would be bad.
Essentia can be piped into the sides of the Condenser and the resulting flux essentia can be drained from the bottom.The Condenser is not all that is needed. I also need a special lattice that will actually draw the flux from the aura. The lattice pieces can be connected to the top of the Condenser and each other to form a multiblock structure. The more pieces I connect, the quicker the Condenser can draw flux from the aura. It does however increase the essentia cost.
The lattice cannot be attached any old way however:
1) The lattice blocks must be attached to the top of the condenser and all the connected lattice pieces must be above the condenser itself.
2) I can attach many lattice blocks together, but any lattice pieces further than 8 blocks from the condenser will automatically detach.
3) It is theoretically possibly to pack a large amount of lattice pieces into this 8 block range, but the benefit a lattice piece provides is reduced for each other lattice piece it is connected to.
4) It may appear that a single unbroken line of lattices would be the best configuration, but occasionally the filter in a lattice piece becomes clogged and unusable. All lattice pieces after the clogged one will no longer aid the conversion speed, though they will still add to the cost. The filter can be replaced by clicking on the clogged lattice piece with a fresh one.
To determine the cost and conversion rate of the Condenser multiblock I can simply use a Resonator on the Condenser itself.
before:
我已經找到一種將靈氣場內的咒波轉化爲腐化源質的方法。腐化源質幾乎不顯良性，但它還是比咒波容易處理。不幸的是，這個過程緩慢且成本高昂。
我製造了 咒波凝結器 的計劃。當提供大量源質時，它能夠從靈氣場中抽取咒波並迫使咒波自身轉化爲源質。從靈氣場中抽取的每個腐化源質都需要5個以上的源質和一些時間來轉化。只要不是腐化源質，任何種類的源質都可以在機器中使用。腐化源質是惡性的。
源質可以通過管道輸送到凝結器的兩側。腐化源質可以在底部排出。只有凝結器是不夠的，我還需要一個能從靈氣場中實際抽取咒波的特殊的格子。格柵可以連接到凝結器的頂部且格柵間可以彼此連接以形成多方塊結構。格柵的連接數量越多，凝結器從靈氣場中抽取咒波的速度就越快。然而它確實增加了源質成本。
但是，格子不能以任何過時的方式連接：
1）格塊必須連接到凝結器的頂部，所有連接的格件必須位於凝結器本身之上。
2）我可以將許多格塊連接在一起，但是距離凝結器8個方塊以外的任何格塊都會自動分離。
3）理論上可以將大量的格柵安裝到這8個方塊的範圍內，但是單個格柵所提供的增益將會因爲連接的每個其他格柵而減少。
4） 看起來可能單個不間斷的格子是最佳構造，但格柵中的過濾器偶爾會被堵塞而不可用。所有堵塞的格柵將不會再加速轉化，雖說它們仍然增加了成本。可以通過點擊堵塞的格件來更換過濾器。
why: 譯文結尾缺漏第4點後半與共振器整段；「任何過時的方式」誤譯 any old way；格子／格柵／格塊用詞混亂；漏譯不少細節。
sonnet_fix:
我已經找到一種將靈氣場內的純粹咒波轉化爲咒波源質的方法。咒波源質算不上良性，但它比原始咒波容易處理得多。不幸的是，這個過程既不簡單、也不便宜，更不快速。
我畫好了咒波凝結器的設計圖。當供應大量源質時，它能夠從靈氣場中抽取咒波並迫使其轉化爲源質。從靈氣場中抽取的每點咒波都需要5點以上的源質和一些時間。只要不使用咒波源質，任何種類的源質都可以使用。用咒波源質就糟了。
源質可以通過管道輸送到凝結器的側面，產生的咒波源質則可以從底部排出。只有凝結器是不夠的，我還需要一種特殊的格柵，才能實際從靈氣場中抽取咒波。格柵件可以連接到凝結器的頂部，也可以彼此相連，形成多方塊結構。連接的件數越多，凝結器從靈氣場中抽取咒波的速度就越快，不過源質成本也會增加。
但是，格柵不能隨便亂接：
1）格柵方塊必須連接到凝結器的頂部，所有相連的格柵件都必須位於凝結器之上。
2）我可以將許多格柵方塊連在一起，但距離凝結器超過8個方塊的格柵件會自動脫落。
3）理論上可以在這8格範圍內塞進大量格柵件，但每個格柵件所提供的增益，會隨其所連接的其他格柵件數量增加而減少。
4）看起來單一條不間斷的格柵似乎是最佳配置，但格柵件中的過濾器偶爾會被堵塞而無法使用。堵塞的那一件之後的所有格柵件將不再有助於提升轉化速度，但仍會增加成本。可以手持新的過濾器點擊堵塞的格柵件來更換。
要確定凝結器多方塊結構的成本和轉化速率，我只需對凝結器本身使用共振器即可。

en:
As I suspected these tears are holes in reality itself. The chaotic energies that flow from them is extremely dangerous and I should find a way to close these rifts as soon as possible.
My observations of the rift itself has revealed some interesting things however. The rifts actually seem to feed on flux - the more flux there is in the environment, the larger they grow. They also grow more unstable over time and eventually this instability causes a burst of pure chaotic energy. This energy can take many forms and is seldom a good thing. Fortunately they regain some stability when this happens. The severity of the chaos burst depends on the size of the rift.
Even though I can't close them yet, maybe I can find some way of keeping them stable.
before:
我懷疑這些裂痕是現實中的漏洞。從它們中流出的混亂能量是極其危險的，所以我必須盡塊找到一種關閉它們的方法。
我對裂隙的觀察揭示了一些有趣的事情。裂隙實際上似乎依賴於咒波 —— 環境中的咒波越多，它們生長得越大。隨着時間的推移，它也會變得更加不穩定，最終這種不穩定性會導致一股純粹混亂的能量爆發。這種能量有多種形式，但很少是有利的。幸運的是，當發生這種情況時，它們會恢復一些穩定。混亂爆發的嚴重程度取決於裂隙的大小。
雖然我還不能關閉它們，但也許我可以找到一些方法來保持它們的穩定。
why: 「盡塊」為錯字（應為儘快）；「裂痕」與「裂隙」混用；feed on 譯為「依賴」不準確。

en:
I have drawn up the plans for an Essentia Smelter. The smelter works much like a normal furnace by burning coal to produce heat, but instead of smelting ore into metal, it breaks down objects into a slurry of raw, unprocessed essentia. This process isn't very efficient and a small amount of essentia is converted into flux roughly 20% of the time.
The next step in the process is to take the essentia slurry and distill it using an Arcane Alembic.
To work, arcane alembics need to be placed on top of a smelter. Multiple alembics can be placed on top of each other to increase storage, but it does not influence processing speed. The essentia slurry will slowly be drawn into the alembic and the individual aspected essentia separated out.
If the smelter is being powered by alumentum, this distillation process is much faster.
The essentia can then be extracted out of an alembic using phials, jars or more complex means.
before:
我已經畫好了源質冶煉廠的藍圖。它就像普通熔爐一樣燃燒煤來產生熱量，不同於熔爐將原礦冶煉成金屬，源質冶煉廠將物品分解成單純、原始的源質黏漿。這個過程並不是非常高效，大約有20%的源質會轉化爲咒波。
下一步就是要利用奧術蒸餾器來分離、純化源質黏漿。
奧術蒸餾器需要放置在冶煉廠頂部。可以放置多個蒸餾器以增加容量，但這樣做不會影響分解速度。源質黏漿會慢慢被抽取到蒸餾器中，分餾成獨立的源質。
如果使用源動之焰作爲冶煉廠的燃料，那麼分餾過程將更迅速。
可以使用要素安瓿，罐子或者別的更復雜的手段取出冶煉廠中的要素。
why: 「復雜」為錯字；20% 的條件被改成「20%的源質」，與原文不符；末句誤說從冶煉廠取出。

en:
Even the most skilled thaumaturge occasionally leaves a mess in the form of flux. It is a nuisance everyone has to deal with, but this machine removes the drudgery involved.
The flux scrubber, when powered with aer vis from a nearby vis relay or energized node, will slowly remove any form of flux, whether Goo or Gas, within 16 blocks of where it is placed. What is more, it is able to reclaim a small portion of the magic that makes up the flux in the form of praecantatio essentia.
Its internal buffer is very small and it will continue operating even when full, so it must be emptied if I wish to reclaim all the essentia.
before:
即便是最老練的神祕使，也難免偶爾留下咒波這樣的爛攤子。這是人人都得應付的麻煩，而這臺機器免去了其中的苦役。
咒波淨化器從周圍的靈氣中抽取魔力，緩慢清除其所在位置16格以內的咒波黏漿。更進一步，它還能把構成咒波的那部分魔力回收爲魔力要素的源質。
它的內部緩衝很小，而且裝滿之後仍會繼續工作，所以想把源質全部回收，就得及時清空。
why: 譯文把供能來源（aer vis、魔力中繼器或充能節點）改成「周圍的靈氣」，並漏掉 Goo 或 Gas 的氣體形式，與英文對不上。
sonnet_fix:

en:
Much like lingering potions can be used to create a static effect in the world, the Cloud medium can be used to create a field of energy that periodically applies focus effects to entities and blocks caught within.
The strength of effects linked to this medium will be reduced significantly.
before:

why: Lingering Potion 官方譯名為殘留藥水而非滯留藥劑，且「烏雲」與標題「雲霧」不一致。

en:
§nAir§0
This effect creates a sudden burst of wind, much like a wind charge. It causes no harm at all, but it hurls back anything caught in it, myself included if I stand too close, and the gust is strong enough to flip levers and swing doors open.§nFrost§0
Fire may be destructive, but intense cold can be nearly as harmful with the added benefit of freezing my enemies to the bone, slowing them to a crawl as the frost bites into them. Creatures at home in the cold, and anyone wrapped in leather, shrug it off.§nEarth§0
The blast of earth and rock created by this effect packs a significant punch. It is even powerful enough to break blocks made from weaker materials.
before:
§n疾風§0
這個效果會創造一道疾風。雖然只會造成少量傷害，但是會擊退任何擊中的物體。§n冰霜§0
火焰可能會帶來毀滅，但是刺骨的寒冷也會傷害我的敵人並使它們緩慢前行。§n大地§0
由這種效果帶來的泥土和岩石的爆炸形成了明顯的衝擊。衝擊威力甚至強大到足以打破由脆弱的材料製成的方塊。
why: 疾風「完全不造成傷害」被譯成會造成少量傷害，且漏掉撥動拉桿、冰霜免疫（耐寒生物與皮革）等內容，為舊版殘稿。
sonnet_fix:
§n疾風§0
這個效果會創造一道突發的疾風，類似風彈。它完全不會造成傷害，但會擊退被捲入的一切，我若站得太近也不例外；這陣風強到足以撥動拉桿、吹開門扉。§n冰霜§0
火焰或許具有毀滅性，但刺骨的寒冷幾乎同樣傷人，還能把我的敵人凍到骨子裡，讓它們在寒霜侵蝕下緩慢爬行。適應寒冷的生物，以及身穿皮革的人，都能無視這種效果。§n大地§0
這個效果所造出的泥土與岩石爆發帶有相當可觀的衝擊力，甚至強大到足以打破以較脆弱材料製成的方塊。

en: I have managed to increase the complexity of foci nearly twofold. By infusing an advanced focus with the energy storage capability of a Primal Pearl and the dense internal structure of a Nether Star I have created a focus that is bigger on the inside - magically speaking. Physically it has the same dimensions as a normal focus, though it is noticeably heavier.
before: 我將法術核心的複雜度提升了接近兩倍。將原初明珠的能量容納性質以及地獄之星的緻密結構注入高等核心，我製造出了更大的核心——魔術意義上說法。外觀上的尺寸與一般核心相同，但明顯更沉重。
why: 「魔術意義上說法」不通順，且漏掉「內部更大」的語意。
sonnet_fix: 我成功將核心的複雜度提升了接近兩倍。將原初明珠的能量儲存能力以及地獄之星的緻密內部結構注入高等核心後，我製造出了一個內部更大的核心——就魔法層面而言。外觀上它與一般核心尺寸相同，但明顯更沉重。

en:
I can now create a quasi-physical construct of vis that can hold focus effects in stasis until triggered. When created, this 'mine' take two seconds to arm. Once it is armed any non-allied entity that gets close enough will cause the mine to dissipate, releasing the stored effects towards the triggering entity.
The mine can be set to trigger on friendlies instead of enemies and neutral creatures.
before:
現在我可以創造一個類似物理結構的魔力以便在未被觸發的情況下控制住讓核心的效果停滯。剛放置下來的時候，這個“地雷”需要2秒鐘的時間準備。一旦準備完畢，任何非友軍目標接近它將會立即被觸發，並釋放存儲在其中的魔法效果射向目標。
地雷可以被設置爲友軍觸發模式而不是敵人或中立生物。
why: 「存儲」「設置」為大陸用語，且最後一句友軍/敵人的觸發對象表述不清。
sonnet_fix:

地雷也可以設定為由友軍觸發，而不是敵人與中立生物。

en:
I have designed a medium pattern that will allow me to plan which blocks I manipulate. This medium works much like Touch, except I will be shown a ghostly outline if which blocks will be manipulated. The range is also much greater (16 blocks). By pressing the focus modify key ('G' by default) I can alter the size of the area. By pressing CTRL + G I can alter the axis in which the size will be changed.
This medium has two modes of operation which I can select between when I add it to a focus: Full and Surface. Full mode affects all possible blocks that match the size, while surface mode will only affect blocks that have an exposed side.
This focus medium cannot be used in combination with any other mediums.
before:
我設計了一種媒介符印來讓我規劃哪些方塊將會被我操縱。這個符印和觸及的工作方式相仿，只是會爲將要受到影響的方塊以高亮顯示。通過 核心調整鍵（默認爲 G）能夠改變區域的大小，通過 Ctrl + G 能夠更改改變大小的方向。
要注意每個受影響的方塊都會增加效果的魔力消耗。
“潛能”修飾會提高這個符印所能夠控制的最大範圍。
why: 譯文為舊版殘稿（提到魔力消耗與「潛能」修飾，缺少完整/表面兩種模式與16格範圍、不可與其他媒介組合），且使用大陸用語「默認」。
sonnet_fix:
我設計了一種媒介符印，讓我能規劃要操縱哪些方塊。這個媒介的運作方式很像接觸，只是會以幽靈般的輪廓顯示將被操縱的方塊，範圍也大得多（16格）。按下核心調整鍵（預設為 G）可以改變區域大小，按下 CTRL + G 則可以更改調整大小所沿的軸向。
這個媒介有兩種運作模式，加入核心時可以選擇：完整與表面。完整模式會影響所有符合大小的方塊，表面模式則只影響至少有一面外露的方塊。
這個核心媒介不能與其他任何媒介組合使用。

en:
Studying other projectiles has taught me two new modifiers.§nBounce§0
Projectiles that follow it rebound off solid surfaces instead of striking them.
§nHoming§0
Carriers that follow it steer toward nearby enemies on their own.
before:
我發現了進一步提升彈丸實用性的方法！§n彈性§0
當這個彈丸撞擊固體表面時，它會彈開。這個彈丸不再會對方塊產生影響，因爲它會在碰到方塊的時候彈開。
§n索敵§0
具有這種特殊屬性的彈丸將會自動將自己引導向敵人飛去。
§n友軍奇圍§0
與索敵相似，不過這種屬性的彈丸只會鎖定友方目標。
why: 英文只有 Bounce 與 Homing 兩項，譯文多出「友軍奇圍」並加入原文沒有的敘述，為舊版殘稿。
sonnet_fix:
研究其他拋射物讓我學會了兩種新的修飾。§n彈跳§0
跟隨其後的拋射物會從固體表面反彈，而不是直接撞上去。
§n追蹤§0
跟隨其後的載體會自行轉向附近的敵人。
after:

§n索敵§0

en:
I have performed a few tentative experiments with dimensional magic. Thus far I have had mixed results, but I am able to reliably shift inanimate matter into an adjacent reality while part of that reality shifts into ours.
I think. Either way, the matter returns unharmed almost every time. Living matter is a different matter - I dare not pen what I saw and I doubt I will attempt that experiment again.
Luckily I think I will be able to replicate this discovery in the form a focus effect.
before:
我對空間魔法進行了一些試驗性的實驗，但是目前爲止我只得到了一些混雜的結果。不過我現在能夠無比可靠地將一切無生命的物質傳送到相鄰的空間，並且將一些物質從相鄰的空間中取出。
我在想，無論用哪種方式，這些物質在傳送的過程當中都不會受到傷害，然而對於生物而言卻不是那麼一回事 — 我不敢相信我所看到的事實，我不確定我會不會再次進行此類實驗。
幸運的是，我能夠將這種發現用符印的方式進行復現。
why: 「dare not pen what I saw」被誤譯為「不敢相信我所看到的事實」，且「空間魔法」與 dimensional 不符、部分句意偏差。
sonnet_fix:
我對維度魔法進行了一些試探性的實驗。到目前為止結果好壞參半，但我能夠穩定地將無生命的物質轉移到相鄰的現實，同時讓那個現實的一部分轉移到我們這裡。
我想是這樣。無論如何，這些物質幾乎每次都能毫髮無傷地回來。生物就是另一回事了——我不敢寫下我所見到的景象，也懷疑自己會再做那個實驗。
幸運的是，我想我能將這項發現以核心效果的形式重現。

en:
I have managed to create a focus that manipulates dimensional magic. Most inanimate objects will be shifted into this other realm temporarily like some sort of portable hole.
The diameter of this hole will remain fixed at around 3 yards, but I should be able to manipulate the depth quite a bit.
before:
我設法創造了一種操作維度魔法的核心。大多數無生命的物體都會像使用了某種便攜蟲洞一樣暫時轉移到另一個空間當中。
這個裂隙的直徑只能是恆定的3碼，但我想我能夠控制它的深度。
why: portable hole 被誤譯為「便攜蟲洞」，「便攜」亦為大陸用語。
sonnet_fix:
我設法創造了一種操作維度魔法的核心。大多數無生命的物體都會暫時被轉移到另一個領域，就像某種可攜式洞穴。
這個洞的直徑固定為約3碼，但我應該能在相當程度上控制它的深度。
after:
我設法創造了一種操作維度魔法的核心。大多數無生命的物體都會像掉進某種可攜式的洞一樣，暫時被轉移到另一個領域。
這個洞的直徑固定在約3碼，但我應該能在相當程度上控制它的深度。

en:
I have managed to split a single medium trajectory into multiple, though not quite to the degree I had hoped. There are two problems:
Firstly is that while I can control the number of forks created from the original trajectory, I have no control over the resulting trajectories once it is split. It simply scatters them in random directions. Fortunately I have figured out how to limit the cone of scatter.
The second problem is that the more forks I create, the weaker the individual effects are. This is not surprising - there is only so much vis I can channel. I mitigate this slightly by drawing in additional vis to bolster the effects, but each resulting fork is still weaker than the original.
This modifier can only be used once in a single focus.
before:
我已經成功的把單彈道分裂成了多個彈道，雖然並沒有完全達到我所期望的程度。還有兩個問題：
首先，雖然我可以控制從原始彈道創建出來的分叉數，但一旦分離，就無法控制分裂的彈道了。它只是隨機的進行分裂。幸運的是，我已經找到了如何限制散射角度椎體的方法。
第二個問題是，我分裂出的彈道越多，分裂出的單體效果就越弱。這並不奇怪——畢竟每次我可以引導的魔力只有有限的量。我通過抽取額外的魔力來減輕這種影響以支撐效果，但是每個分裂的彈道仍然比原始的弱。
這個修正項在一枚核心中只能使用一次。
why: 「椎體」應為「錐體」（錯字），部分句子不通順。

en:
I have created a medium pattern that conjures an arcane bat and infuses it with focus effects. It will hunt down enemies and repeatedly inflict the focus effects on them.
The bats have limited lifespans, are fragile and each time they attack they also lose some of the vis holding them together.
The bat can be set to target friendlies instead of enemies and neutral creatures.
before:
我製作了一種核心媒介，它能夠召喚出一隻奧術蝙蝠並將核心效果注入其中。它會追蹤敵人並且對他們反覆施加核心效果。
召喚出的巫蝠生命非常有限並且非常脆弱，它在攻擊敵人時也會使它們凝聚成形所必須的魔力部分流失。
巫蝠也可以設置爲攻擊友方單位，而不是攻擊敵人或中立生物。

en:
While the Scatter modifier has proven quite useful, it splits a trajectory without any regard for what follows. I realise now my original plan was too ambitious.
I should start smaller.

千里之行，始於足下，我應當從簡單做起。

en:
I have designed the Branch, a flow part that forks a spell into several paths. Every branch receives the same targets, so one cast can apply entirely different effects at once.
Branches can be nested, though each one adds to the complexity of the focus.
before:
我已經完成了兩個新的核心修飾的設計草稿。第一個會將單一目標分裂爲兩個目標，可以讓我對兩個目標施加不同的效果。
第二個修飾是相同的，除了它會讓彈道分裂。
唯一的缺點是分裂會減少放置在它們之下的任何效果的力量，儘管我減輕了這種影響。
令我驚訝的是，我發現這些修飾可以遞歸的分隔，允許我做一些有趣的核心設計。
why: 譯文描述兩個新修飾、彈道分裂與力量減弱，與英文的 Branch 流程部件完全對不上，為舊版殘稿。
sonnet_fix:
我設計出了分支，這是一種能將法術分叉成數條路徑的流程部件。每個分支都會收到相同的目標，因此一次施法就能同時施加完全不同的效果。
分支可以巢狀嵌套，不過每一層都會增加核心的複雜度。

en:
It holds. A warded block cannot be mined, burned, pushed by pistons, or torn apart by explosions, and no creature strong enough to chew through walls will make a mark on it. The block underneath is untouched - remove the ward and it is exactly the stone it always was.
Only I can lift my own wards, and casting the effect a second time on a block I warded will do so. Another thaumaturge's work is beyond me.
The runes are invisible until I hold a focus bearing this pattern, at which point every ward within sight glows: warm gold for mine, dull red for someone else's.
There is a vis cost for each block bound this way, so warding a fortress will not be cheap. Combined with the Plan medium I can at least lay down a wall in one casting.

en:
Who needs projectiles when they can hurl bolts of magical energy? They affect their target instantly and aiming them is a lot easier.
Unfortunately their range is limited. Trying to keep the vis stream coherent beyond 16 blocks has proven difficult. For longer range engagements, projectiles are still superior.
before:
當你能夠直接射出魔法電弧的時候，誰還會接着使用投射物來攻擊。震擊能夠瞬間命中目標並且更容易瞄準。
不過震擊的射程比較有限。實驗證明，想要在16格之外凝聚束狀的魔力流非常困難。因此，拋射符印在應對遠處的敵人時依然顯得更爲輕鬆。

不過雷光的射程有限。實驗證明，想要在16格之外維持魔力流的凝聚非常困難。因此，在應對遠處的敵人時，拋射物依然更為出色。

en:
This simple device allows a golemancer to bring their golems to a temporary halt.
If this block is activated with a redstone signal any golem that passes over it will come to complete standstill and cease its current task.
Once this block is deactivated the golem will once again go about its business.

一旦方塊不再被激活，傀儡便會重新去做自己的事。

en:
I can now sneak + right click with the §5Golemancer's Bell§0 to bring up an inventory of all items accessible by provider seals within 32 blocks. I can then request items from this list and a golem will deliver it.
If I clicked on a block the item will be delivered to the block, or placed inside if it is an inventory. The side you clicked on will be taken into account.
If I clicked on empty air the item will be delivered directly to me.Golems are still limited by their range so I must take care where I try and deliver items to.

如果我點擊的是一個方塊，這個物品將被放置在這個方塊處，如果點的是個容器的話，會被放入容器中。你點擊的方塊的面也會被記錄下來。

en: Some substances are simple enough that just adding more of the same essentia it contains is enough to create more of that substance. This isn't true for everything, but the phenomenon will probably prove useful.
before: 有些物質只需要單純的添加其包含的源質就可以進行複製。雖然這非適用於所有物品，但是這種現象被證實相當有效。

en:
I have discovered a way to manage the flux generated by the smelting process. By running the slurry through a secondary set of venting ports fitted with filters I am able to separate out the flux and safely vent it as harmless steam.
Like the slurry pumps, the vents need to be placed on the side of the smelter.
This process will reduce flux produced by about a third and additional vents will increase this, though there are diminishing returns.
before:
我還研究出一種管理冶煉過程中產生的咒波的方法。讓源質黏漿流經源質過濾器的附加裝置，就能夠將咒波分離出來，將它變成安全無害的蒸汽排放出來。
就像粘液泵一樣，這個排放口也要放在冶煉廠側面。
還可以加裝第三級裝置來進一步減少咒波產量，但隨着加裝的排放口數量增多增加的效果會衰減。
why: 原文為減少約三分之一、加裝排放口效果遞減，譯文誤成「第三級裝置」而不符原意；「粘液泵」與前文「黏漿泵」不一致。

這個過程能將咒波產量減少約三分之一，加裝更多排放口可進一步提升效果，但報酬會遞減。

en:
I took a trip to the nether and was inspired by what I found there. By harnessing raw §cIgnis§0 within a furnace crafted from obsidian, netherbrick and a pinch of Salis Mundus I will be able to make a highly efficient and fuel free furnace. So efficient in fact, that occasionally it will produce bonus materials in the form of nuggets, rare earths or other items.
While this is essentially free, it is also very slow unless the furnace gets a steady supply of vis from the aura. It should be noted that the furnace will occasionally create a small amount of flux as well. I'm sure it is nothing to worry about.Anything dropped into the top of the furnace will be smelted down and spit out the front - if the object is not normally smeltable it will be destroyed.
I can place a chest or other container directly in front of the furnace to have it eject items into it.Cooking meat in the infernal furnace will produce meaty chunks as a byproduct. I can combine three different types of these chunks with sugar for a delicious and invigorating treat.
before:
我去了一趟下界，並在那找到了靈感。利用天然§c火§0要素的神奇力量，你使用下界磚以及黑曜石和一小撮世界鹽構築了這個高效且不需要任何燃料的熔爐。實際上，它是如此的高效，有時甚至會額外地以顆粒或錠狀的形式產出所燒的礦物。
但是，不消耗魔力的煉獄熔爐冶煉速度非常緩慢，倘若想要高效地使用它需要保證穩定地供應魔力。值得注意的是熔爐有時會產生一些咒波。當然，這沒啥好擔心的。任何從煉獄熔爐上方投入的物品都會被熔煉——如果是不可熔煉的物品則會被銷燬
當然，你可以在煉獄熔爐的正前方放置一個容器來接住這個熔爐吐出來的產物。在煉獄熔爐中烹煮肉類會額外產出肉塊。我可以把三種不同的肉塊與糖一起合成，做成一份美味而提神的點心。
why: 「下界」應為官方譯名「地獄」；人稱錯用「你」；額外產出誤為「錠狀」（原文為顆粒、稀土）；魔力供應條件被譯歪；「銷燬」為錯字。

en:
I have cracked the problem and should now be able to add infusion enchantments to most tools or weapons. Some enchantments can be applied multiple times to the same item, but each rank has an increased essentia cost when crafted.
Each different infusion enchantment on the item also increases the cost by 33% and has an increased chance of giving it the Warping property.
Certain infusion enchantments can only be applied to specific tools or weapons. This will be listed under each individual entry that follows.
Tools with infusion enchantments can still be enchanted with the normal enchanting table and visa versa.
Like with the elemental tools, sneaking while using an infusion enchanted tool will suppress its abilities.§oCollector§r
Whenever this tool harvests an item it will automatically float towards you.
§oRanks§r: none
§oTarget§r: axe, pickaxe, shovel, weapon§oBurrowing§r
When you try to harvest a tree or ore the furthest block will be harvested, instead of the one you are trying to break.
§oRanks§r: none
§oTarget§r: axe, pickaxe§oRefining§r
Whenever you harvest ore there is a chance of gaining a native cluster instead. Increasing the rank of the enchant will improve the chance.
§oRanks§r: 1-4
§oTarget§r: pickaxe§oSounding§r
You can sneak + right click on a block with this tool to send out a sounding pulse. This pulse will reveal any ores hidden nearby. Using this ability will cause some damage to the tool.
§oRanks§r: 1-4
§oTarget§r: pickaxe§oDestructive§r
When you harvest a block the 8 blocks surrounding (3x3 area) it will also be harvested if they are normally harvestable by the tool. Each additional block harvested causes durability loss as if you had harvested them by hand.
§oRanks§r: none
§oTarget§r: axe, pickaxe, shovel§oArcing§r
When you strike an enemy with a weapon enchanted with this, an arc of biting wind will hit an additional target nearby for half your weapons damage. Additional ranks will increase the number of additional targets and the range.
§oRanks§r: 1-4
§oTarget§r: weapon§oEssence Harvester§r
When you you kill a creature with a weapon enchanted with this it has a chance of dropping some of its essence in crystal form. Increasing the rank of this enchantment increases the chance of crystals dropping and may also increase the number dropped.
§oRanks§r: 1-5
§oTarget§r: weapon§oLamplighter§r
When you break a block this enchantment will place an invisible and intangible light source at the location if the light level is below 10.
§oRanks§r: none
§oTarget§r: axe, pickaxe, shovel
Should I ever regret an infusion, a grindstone reworked with thaumium and set with arcane stone can draw the infused magic back out of an item, leaving any ordinary enchantments untouched. Some of the experience that went into the infusion is returned to me as it is ground away.
before:
你發現了將這些能力套用在其他任何工具上的技術，而不僅限於神祕工具。
某些附魔特性可以疊加，但每級附魔都會增加源質消耗。
每新增一項附魔同樣會增加33%的注魔源質消耗，同時，這也會增加該工具扭曲的概率。
某些注魔附魔只能應用於特定的工具或武器。詳細內容請見下文。
經過注魔附魔的工具仍然能施加一般附魔，反之亦然。
類似元素工具，可以通過潛行使用來抑制其特殊能力。§o收集§r
這項附魔工具所開採的所有物品都會自動飄向你。
§l附魔等級§r：無
§l附魔對象§r：斧，鎬，鍬，武器§o奔流§r
類似奔流斧，帶有這項附魔的工具在破壞方塊時會從距離你所挖掘方塊最遠的相同方塊開始挖掘。
§l附魔等級§r：無
§l附魔對象§r：斧，鎬§o精練§r
類似熾心鎬，這項附魔使你在開採礦石時偶爾會獲得原礦簇。掉落概率隨附魔等級而提升。
§l附魔等級§r：1-4
§l附魔對象§r：鎬§o勘探§r
類似熾心鎬，使用帶有該附魔的工具右擊方塊以勘探附近的礦石。這項操作會消耗一些工具耐久度。
§l附魔等級§r：1-4
§l附魔對象§r：鎬§o破壞§r
使用帶有該附魔的工具破壞方塊時會連帶目標方塊周圍的8個可被該工具破壞的方塊一起破壞。每個被破壞的方塊都會按照正常開採來扣除工具耐久度。
§l附魔等級§r：無
§l附魔對象§r：斧，鎬，鍬§o弧光§r
類似風雷劍，當你使用帶有該附魔的武器進行攻擊時可以觸發連鎖閃電的特性，彈射的電弧會對周圍的目標造成一半的傷害。電弧的目標數及範圍隨附魔等級而提升
§l附魔等級§r：1-4
§l附魔對象§r：武器§o晶化§r
被帶有該項附魔的武器所擊殺的生物有幾率掉落其所含要素對應的晶化源質。掉落概率及數量隨附魔等級而提升。
§l附魔等級§r：1-5
§l附魔對象§r：武器§o燈光§r
當你破壞一個方塊時，如果該位置的亮度低於10，這個附魔將會在此處放置一個不可見的光源。
§l附魔等級§r：無
§o附魔對象§r: 斧，鎬，鍬
why: 為舊版殘稿：缺開頭與砂輪段落、多出英文沒有的「類似奔流斧」等內容、潛行條件遺漏，且標籤與色碼（<DIV>/§l）與原文不符。

我已破解了這個難題，現在應該能為大多數工具或武器加上注魔附魔。有些附魔可以對同一物品疊加多次，但每提高一級，合成時的源質消耗就會增加。
物品上每多一種不同的注魔附魔，成本也會再增加33%，並提高其獲得扭曲屬性的機率。

§o附魔對象§r：鎬§o破壞§r

§o附魔等級§r：無
§o附魔對象§r：斧、鎬、鍬§o弧光§r
以附有此附魔的武器攻擊敵人時，一道銳利的風弧會對附近另一個目標造成你武器一半的傷害。提高等級會增加額外目標數量與範圍。
§o附魔等級§r：1-4
§o附魔對象§r：武器§o晶化§r
以附有此附魔的武器殺死生物時，有機會以結晶形式掉落其部分要素。提高附魔等級會增加結晶掉落機率，也可能增加掉落數量。
§o附魔等級§r：1-5
§o附魔對象§r：武器§o燈光§r
破壞方塊時，若該處亮度低於10，此附魔會在該位置放置一個不可見且無實體的光源。

en:
Infusion has proven to be much more unstable than I expected. Placing occult paraphernalia does mitigate the effect somewhat, but much less than the texts suggested. The more items of the same type you place, the less effective they are.
I need to find more effective ways of mitigating instability. Strangely enough, I think mundane technology might have the answer.
It is well known that mundane power sources like redstone interferes with thaumaturgy. Of course, throwing redstone into the mix of an already unstable infusion is not the answer, but maybe there is some way to harness the interference.
before:

我需要找到更有效的方法來減少這種不穩定性。說來也怪，我認爲那些平庸的技術中或許可以給我答案。
衆所周知，平庸的能源比如紅石，可以作用於神祕學。當然，將紅石混入已經很不穩定的注魔中必然不是一個理想的方案，但或許可以利用它這種干預的特性。

en:
While not true flight, the Arcane Levitator is the next best thing.
When placed the levitator lifts any item or creature above it up to 8 blocks into the air. A sneaking creature or player will be slowly lowered.
While levitating something it consumes 1 vis per second from the aura.
The levitator can be placed in any orientation, and when placed horizontally will push creatures along while keeping them aloft.
A toggle on the back of the device allows you to alter the range at which it operates, but also changes the amount of vis it uses.

當有生物懸浮時它每秒鐘會消耗1 vis。
懸浮台可以面朝任何方向放置，當水平放置時它會在推開生物的同時保持它們懸浮。
位於懸浮台後部的觸發器可以用來調整懸浮距離並同時影響魔力的消耗。

en:
I have discovered a way to reanimate a zombie brain and put it to my own dark uses.
It retains some of the hunger it possessed as a zombie and while it cannot consume brains, it still enjoys eating the thoughts and experiences of those slain nearby. Giving the jar a good shake will make it surrender some of its ill-gotten gains for my own use.
It will only hold a certain amount of experience. Particle effects will be displayed above the jar when it is full.
This jar can also be used to a much greater effect than bookcases to improve mundane enchanting.

en:
Any living creatures bathed in the gentle pink glow of this lamp is immediately placed in a much more romantic mood. If they are able, they will seek others of their kind to mate.
This lamp will have no effect if there is 8 or more of a particular species already present.
It requires §dDesiderium§0 essentia to function which can be fed to the lamp by attaching it directly to an essentia piping system.
The lamp can be turned off by applying a redstone signal.

若某種動物已經達到8只或以上，這種燈便不會再對其造成影響。
它需要§d貪婪要素§0源質來驅動。可以直接將育種燈安附在源質管道系統中。

en:
Unlike the Arcane lamp from which it is made, the Lamp of Growth does not cast much light unless it is provided with §2Herba§0 essentia. If this is done, any plants which grow where its light shines the brightest will grow much faster than normal.
Essentia can be fed to the lamp by attaching it directly to an essentia piping system.
The lamp can be turned off by applying a redstone signal.

In my opinion it is the best mundane material for Golemancy purposes, and I would not dream of crafting intricate devices from any other material.
It is quite pleasing to the eye as well.

The elemental tools have proven quite useful, but the method I use to enchant them is inflexible. I must discover a way to apply many of the same abilities to nearly any tool or weapon, not just thaumium tools.
A good place to start would be to study a normal enchantment and see how I can apply some of those primitive principles to the infusion process.

先研究一般的附魔，看看如何把其中一些原始的原理應用到注魔過程中，會是個好的開始。

en:
Golemancy places great demands on my craftsmanship as it often requires intricate components with very narrow margins for error. I will need to increase my skill and knowledge of both mundane and arcane materials. My first target is wood.
Wood is a versatile substance and despite its weakness, it is light and easy to work. I have found Greatwood to be a superior wood particularly well suited to golemancy.
I should learn as much about it as I can.

en:
As predicted, the Clockwork Minds I have created offers very little in the way of abstract reasoning and autonomy. Attempting to create more complex clockworks has met with very little success, so I am turning to something I already know will work: living brains.
By studying them, I might be able to unlock the secret behind true intelligence and autonomy!

通過對這些研究，我也許能夠揭開真正的智慧和自主思考的祕密。

en:
Iron golems, snow golems and similar creations that anyone can throw together all have the same thing in common - they are unpredictable and uncontrollable.
The spirits that animate them are wild and follow their own will. This is a problem.
If I am going to create intelligent magical servants then I will have to give them a mind that is willing to take orders. The simplest solution is a clockwork construct quickened by Thaumaturgy.
Designing one will be no simple feat, however.

如果你打算製造一些智能的魔力僕人，你就得考慮賦予它們能夠接受命令的思維。最簡單的解決方案是製造出一個使用神祕學驅動的發條裝置。
這似乎並沒有我預期的這麼簡單。

I have managed to crack artificial intelligence in the form of a magically powered clockwork mind. It has its limitations and very little autonomy, but it is a start.
Of course, now that I have a mind it is time to put it to use. I should draw up some designs for golems along with a way to craft them.

en:
I have designed a special press that will allow me to craft simple golems. It includes an anvil and forge to make assembling the parts easier.To assemble a golem I simply need to access the Golem Press and select the components I wish to craft the golem from. For now the selection is fairly limited, but I am sure I will develop more.Actually designing a golem is fairly straightforward: Each golem is made up from up to 5 components: The base material, a type of head, arms, legs and an optional addon module. Simply select which of these you want to use and a list of crafting components will be displayed on the right. You need to have the listed components in your inventory before you can start the crafting process.
Listed in the middle of the interface you will see the traits, hearts, armor and damage the golem will possess.
Lastly you will need to supply Machina essentia to the press. Several ports are provided below the main press mechanism for this purpose.You can now place the golem wherever you wish, but it will not do much unless you also place down a §5Golem Control Seal§0. To learn more about them see the reseach category that you have unlocked.
When they have no tasks to perform, golems will return to the spot they were originally placed. You can pick up a golem by right clicking on it while sneaking.
It is also possible to assign a color to a golem by clicking on it with dye. This is useful for limiting it to specific seals. Picking up the golem will clear the color assigned to it.
before:
我設計了一個傀儡塑形裝置來壓制出傀儡的基礎部件。此外，這個裝置還自帶鐵砧和熔爐方便就地組裝壓制好的部件我只需要在傀儡塑形裝置的界面中選擇傀儡各部件的類型，並提供所需的材料和源質，傀儡工坊會自動組裝出成品。雖然現在可供選擇的傀儡部件並不多，但我相信未來可以開發出更多的部件。每個傀儡由五個部分組成：基礎材料，頭部類型，手臂結構，腿部功能，以及一個可選的額外組件。只需在界面中選定所需部件，耗材列表便會在右邊顯示。你必須確保上列材料已經在你的包裹裏，然後才能開始製作傀儡。
界面中間的列表會顯示出傀儡的各項屬性及特性。
最後你還需要給傀儡工坊提供一些機械要素的源質。傀儡工坊的壓制裝置下方開口可以用來導入源質。你現在可以放置傀儡，但是如果在傀儡的視野範圍內沒有放置的§5傀儡控制印記§0，傀儡將幾乎不做任何事。欲知詳情，請參閱你最近解鎖的研究。
當它們無所事事時，傀儡會回到最初被放置的位置。你可以通過潛行右擊來收回傀儡。
你也可以通過手持染料右擊來給傀儡染色。這會對限制傀儡執行指定印記十分有幫助。收回傀儡將清空當前傀儡的染色效果。
why: 「界面」「包裹」為大陸用語；機器名稱前後不一（傀儡塑形裝置／傀儡工坊）；多處與原文不符（forge 譯成熔爐、「視野範圍內」「機械要素的源質」等）。
sonnet_fix:
我設計了一台特殊的壓製機，能讓我製作簡單的傀儡。它附帶鐵砧和鍛爐，讓零件組裝更加輕鬆。要組裝傀儡，只需開啟傀儡壓製機，選擇想用來製作傀儡的各個組件。目前可選項目相當有限，但我相信之後還會開發出更多。設計傀儡其實相當簡單：每個傀儡最多由五個組件構成：基礎材料、頭部類型、手臂、腿部，以及一個可選的附加模組。只要選好想使用的項目，右側就會顯示所需的製作材料。開始製作前，這些材料必須已在你的物品欄中。
介面中間會列出該傀儡將具備的特性、生命值、護甲與傷害。
最後，你需要為壓製機提供機械源質。主壓製機構下方設有數個連接埠供此用途。現在你可以把傀儡放在任何地方，但除非你同時放置§5傀儡控制印記§0，否則它不會有多少作為。想進一步了解，請參閱你已解鎖的研究分類。
沒有任務可執行時，傀儡會回到最初被放置的位置。潛行時對傀儡按右鍵即可將其拾起。
也可以手持染料點擊傀儡來為其指定顏色，這有助於把它限制在特定的印記上。拾起傀儡會清除其顏色。

en:
I am now able to enchant a pair of magical mirrors that act as doorways to the void between the worlds. Anything shoved (or piped) through one mirror will pass through this strange realm and emerge from the other mirror - even across dimensional boundaries.
Unfortunately this realm is extremely hostile to mortal creatures like myself so using these mirrors to transport living creatures is not yet possible.
To link a pair of these magical mirrors you simply need to place one of them in a desired location. You then right-click with a second mirror on the one you placed, and the pair will become linked. You may then place the second wherever you wish and items thrown into one will be ejected out the other.
Mirrors can only be linked in pairs, so while both are placed in the world and able to transmit items you cannot link them to another mirror. When you pick up a mirror it will remember the last partner it was linked with, allowing you to easily move it without having to relink it. While one of the paired mirrors is picked up, you may easily relink either of them.
Transporting items through mirrors places stress on the magical aura. Every now and again this causes Flux to be generated. The more items you transport, the more flux is generated.
before:
你嘗試附魔鏡子，將它變成通往世界間隙那廣漠虛空的傳送門。投入其（或是使用管道向鏡子輸入）的物品將會跨越空間甚至跨越位面，然後從另外一面鏡子噴出。
不幸的是空間通道對像你這樣的實體生物非常排斥，因此用這種魔鏡來傳輸生物暫時是不可能的。
要鏈接一對魔鏡，你需要將其中一面鏡子安裝在目標位置。並用第二面鏡子右擊第一名鏡子，並安裝在需要的位置。當兩面都裝好後會建立連接，鏡面會出現黑洞的圖案。當你將物品投入其中，物品會自動從另一個鏡子被拋出。
魔鏡只能成對鏈接。當安裝好後不能與第三個魔鏡建立鏈接。當你拆卸後重新安裝魔鏡的時候，它能夠自動回憶上次建立配對的魔鏡。然而，拆卸配對的魔鏡後，你也能很方便地用它建立新的鏈接。
通過鏡子傳輸物品會對當地的靈氣平衡造成壓力，每次傳輸物品，都會產生咒波污染，傳輸物品越多，污染越甚。
why: 連結步驟是舊版殘稿（多出黑洞圖案、順序與原文不符）；「Every now and again」被譯成每次都產生；「第一名鏡子」錯字。
sonnet_fix:
我現在能夠附魔一對魔鏡，使其成為通往世界間虛空的門戶。任何被塞入（或以管道輸入）其中一面鏡子的物品，都會穿過這片奇異的領域，從另一面鏡子中出現——甚至能跨越維度的界線。
不幸的是，這片領域對像我這樣的凡間生物極為敵對，因此目前還無法用這些鏡子運送活物。
要連結一對魔鏡，只需將其中一面放置在想要的位置，接著手持第二面鏡子對著剛放置的那面按右鍵，兩者便會連結。之後你可以把第二面放在任何地方，投入其中一面的物品會從另一面彈出。
魔鏡只能成對連結，因此當兩面都已放置在世界中並能傳輸物品時，無法再將它們連結到其他鏡子。拾起鏡子時，它會記住上一個連結的夥伴，讓你能輕鬆搬動而不必重新連結。當成對鏡子中有一面被拾起時，你可以輕鬆地重新連結其中任何一面。
透過鏡子傳輸物品會對魔法靈氣造成壓力，時不時會因此產生咒波。傳輸的物品越多，產生的咒波就越多。
after:
我現在能夠附魔一對魔鏡，使其成為通往世界間虛空的門戶。任何被塞入（或以管道輸入）其中一面鏡子的物品，都會穿過這片奇異的領域，從另一面鏡子中出現——甚至能跨越維度的界線。
不幸的是，這片領域對像我這樣的凡間生物極為敵對，因此目前還無法用這些鏡子運送活物。
要連結一對魔鏡，只需將其中一面放置在想要的位置，接著手持第二面鏡子對著剛放置的那面按右鍵，兩者便會連結。之後你可以把第二面放在任何地方，投入其中一面的物品會從另一面彈出。
魔鏡只能成對連結，因此當兩面都已放置在世界中並能傳輸物品時，無法再將它們連結到其他鏡子。拾起鏡子時，它會記住上一個連結的夥伴，讓你能輕鬆搬動而不必重新連結。當成對鏡子中有一面被拾起時，你可以輕鬆地重新連結其中任何一面。
透過鏡子傳輸物品會對魔法靈氣造成壓力，時不時會因此產生咒波。傳輸的物品越多，產生的咒波就越多。

en:
I have created a magical hand mirror that functions in much the same way as other magical mirrors. I simply push items through the glass and they will pop out at the linked mirror.
Right-click while holding the linked hand mirror and I will be able to place any items in my inventory into the looking glass to have them transported.
The hand mirror can be linked to a mirror that is already paired with another.
I should note that the hand mirror can only send items, not receive them.
before:
魔力手鏡類似普通的魔鏡。但首先，正如其名，它可以隨身攜帶，手持已經鏈接到目標魔鏡的手鏡右擊就可以打開界面，將物品放入魔鏡中的格子即可以實現傳遞，他們會被另一端的魔鏡吐出來。
其次，魔力手鏡能夠通過右鍵與新的魔鏡綁定。你能夠使用手鏡來方便地將物品進行傳輸。
手鏡能夠鏈接到已經鏈接過其他手鏡的魔鏡上。
注意手鏡只能傳出物品，不能接收物品。

手持已連結的手鏡按右鍵，就能將物品欄中的任何物品放入鏡中傳送。

en:
Warded jars have proven themselves capable of storing all manner of mundane and mystical things, and you believe you have discovered another use for them - trapping aura nodes.
By enclosing a node in a shell of glass capped with a roof of wooden slabs and striking the glass with a wand, the node will become trapped inside a jar which can then be safely picked up and moved around. The trapping ritual demands a heavy price of vis from your wand and has a very good chance of damaging the node.
While trapped the node is dormant: it runs none of its stranger behaviors and only sips at the local aura, refilling at half its normal rate. Vis can still be drawn from it with a wand.
It is possible to free the node from the jar by clicking on it with a wand. The jar will be destroyed in the process.
before:
源質罐子已被證明能夠儲存各種世俗與神祕之物，而你相信自己又發現了它們的新用途——捕捉靈氣節點。
用玻璃殼將節點包圍，蓋上木質臺階做成的屋頂，再用杖擊打玻璃，節點便會被困入罐中，隨後可被安全地拾起並搬運。捕捉儀式需要你的法杖付出高昂的魔力代價，且極有可能損傷節點。
被困期間節點處於休眠狀態：它不會表現出任何怪異行爲，只會小口啜飲當地靈氣，以正常速度的一半緩慢補充。依然可以用法杖從中抽取魔力。
用杖點擊罐子，便能將節點從中釋放。這一過程中罐子會被摧毀。

en:
Advanced Node Stabilizers perform all the functions of the lesser versions with a few major differences.
Firstly they still prevent lesser nodes from having their vis drained, but they do allow stabilized nodes to drain the vis from lesser ones.
Secondly they have a higher chance to improve unstable and fading nodes.
Unfortunately this costs a lot more power from the stabilized node - still not enough to drain vis from it, but even the brightest node will have its refill rate almost completely negated.
before:
高級節點穩定器具備低階版本的全部功能，但有幾處重大區別。
首先，它們仍能防止低級節點的魔力被抽取，但確實允許穩定後的節點從低級節點中抽取魔力。
其次，它們改善震盪節點與凋零節點的幾率更高。
不幸的是，這會從穩定後的節點消耗多得多的能量——仍不足以從中抽取魔力，但即使是最明亮的節點，其補充速度也會幾乎被完全抵消。
why: unstable 在前文譯為「不穩定節點」，此處卻譯成「震盪節點」，譯名不一致。
