en:
This is even more dangerous than it sounds however and careful steps must be taken during the entire process.
Firstly the node needs to be stabilized during the entire process - a Node Stabilizer placed directly beneath it will serve. Take great care that no redstone signal ever reaches the stabilizer itself: a powered stabilizer shuts down, and the moment it does the transduction grinds to a halt. Once that is done you need to craft and place a Node Transducer above the node. When you apply a redstone signal to the transducer - and only the transducer - the node will begin converting to an energized node and quickly lose its stored vis in the process.
The process takes some time, but when it is done the node will change into an energized node. Caution should be taken to keep both the stabilizer and transducer active from now on - if the transducer loses its redstone signal for too long, the node will revert and its energies will be lost. Far worse, should the stabilizer beneath an energized node ever be removed or switched off, the node will tear itself apart in a violent explosion, fouling the aura and spewing flux goo and gas all around.An energized node is a changed thing. The widened gateway admits only the purest currents: any compound aspects the node once held are torn apart into their primal components for as long as it remains energized, and will only settle back into their old forms should the node ever revert.
The node no longer condenses vis at its own gentle pace. Instead it gulps raw vis straight from the local aura to keep itself brimming - a swift but terribly wasteful process that will strain the aura of the surrounding land. Curiously, a tainted node put to the transducer gorges on flux instead, scouring its surroundings clean as it feeds.
The widened gate also drowns out a node's wilder urges. A hungry node ceases its endless devouring, a tainted node stops spreading corruption, and a dark node no longer calls horrors to its side - for as long as the energy flows.
Best of all, the torrent can be tapped like any other node: draw from it directly with a wand, or let a Recharge Pedestal placed nearby feed it into any wand resting upon it.
I suspect this steady stream could even be caught and carried elsewhere - a matter worth further research.
before:
然而這比聽上去更加危險，整個過程務必步步謹慎。
首先，節點在整個過程中都必須保持穩定——直接放置在其正下方的節點穩定器即可勝任。千萬注意，不要讓任何紅石信號觸及穩定器本身：通電的穩定器會關閉，而一旦關閉，轉換便會戛然而止。完成這步之後，你需要製作一個節點換能器並放置在節點上方。當你向換能器——而且只能是換能器——通入紅石信號時，節點便會開始轉變爲充能節點，並在此過程中迅速失去其儲存的魔力。
這一過程需要一些時間，但完成後節點就會變成充能節點。此後務必小心保持穩定器與換能器始終處於激活狀態——若換能器失去紅石信號過久，節點就會恢復原狀，其能量也會隨之散失。充能節點是已改變之物。被拓寬的門戶只接納最純粹的洪流：節點曾經持有的任何複合要素，在充能期間都會被撕碎爲原初成分，唯有當節點恢復原狀時，纔會重新凝結爲舊有的形態。
節點不再以自己溫和的節奏凝聚魔力，而是直接從當地靈氣中大口吞嚥原始魔力以維持盈滿——迅捷卻極爲浪費，會壓迫周遭土地的靈氣。奇妙的是，被放入換能器的腐化節點反倒會吞噬咒波，在進食的同時滌清四周。
拓寬的門戶也會淹沒節點更狂野的衝動。飢餓節點會停止無盡的吞噬，腐化節點會停止擴散腐化，兇險節點也不再喚來可怖之物——只要能量仍在流動。
最妙的是，這股洪流能像其他節點一樣被取用：直接用法杖從中抽取，或讓置於近旁的充能基座把它注入任何放在其上的法杖。
我懷疑這股穩定的溪流甚至能被截取並輸送往別處——這值得進一步研究。
why: 漏譯一整句：穩定器被移除或關閉時節點會猛烈爆炸並散布咒波黏液與氣體。

節點不再以自己溫和的節奏凝聚魔力，而是直接從當地靈氣中大口吞嚥原始魔力以維持盈滿——迅捷卻極爲浪費，會壓迫周遭土地的靈氣。奇妙的是，被放入換能器的腐化節點反倒會吞噬咒波，在進食的同時滌清四周。
拓寬的門戶也會淹沒節點更狂野的衝動。飢餓節點會停止無盡的吞噬，腐化節點會停止擴散腐化，兇險節點也不再喚來可怖之物——只要能量仍在流動。
最妙的是，這股洪流能像其他節點一樣被取用：直接用法杖從中抽取，或讓置於近旁的充能基座把它注入任何放在其上的法杖。
我懷疑這股穩定的溪流甚至能被截取並輸送往別處——這值得進一步研究。

en:
It was all so simple. I am amazed the Crimson Cultists never discovered this.
Four Eldritch Eyes seated upon the keystone, then a slow, steady discharge of vis channeled through my wand into the altar. I must hold the channel until the Eye opens. If I wander off or the aura runs dry the working fizzles and the vis is lost, though the eyes stay seated.
A warning to myself: once three eyes are in place the obelisk stirs, and its guardians come looking for whoever is meddling with it.
The eyes are spent in the opening, and a keystone left empty will take four more. Seat them and channel again and the door swings onto somewhere else entirely. An altar already used is not an altar exhausted.
Of course I have no idea what that means. No matter, only fools fear the unknown!

一切都那麼簡單——我驚訝於血腥邪徒竟然從未發現這一點。
把四隻異象之眼安放在拱頂石上，再以法杖將一股聚焦的魔力注入祭壇。當地靈氣付出代價，所謂的「眼」便就此睜開。
這些眼睛在開眼時便已耗盡，而空着的拱頂石還要再填上四隻。重新就位並再次引導，那扇門便會通向別處——被使用過的祭壇，並不是被耗盡的祭壇。
當然，我完全不知道那意味着什麼。無妨——只有傻瓜纔會畏懼未知！

en:
This has been an effort in frustration, but I have managed to salvage some success from the jaws of failure. I can indeed replicate the magical effects of a potion by combining the essentia it contains, but the result is extremely volatile. There is no way to simply decant the results into a potion bottle - at least none that I have found so far.
The volatile substance immediately dissipates when exposed to air, but it can still transfer the magical effects to anything nearby, much like splash potion.
I have crafted something that I am calling a Potion Sprayer. You supply it with a potion that acts as a template and then provide it with the correct types of essentia. The sprayer will then manufacture a dose of the potion and store it internally. I can store up to 8 such doses.
When it receives a redstone signal it will emit a single dose of the potion in a 3x3x3 area in front of it.
before:
這是一段艱難的嘗試，但是我依然從失敗的海洋當中撈出了些許成果。我確實可以通過結合藥水所擁有的源質來複制它的魔法效果，但是得到的結果非常不穩定，沒有簡單可行的方法將得到的結果裝入空瓶——至少目前爲止我還沒有發現這樣的方法。
得到的不穩定物質暴露在空氣中將會迅速消散，但是它的魔法效果依然會施加到周圍的任何物體上，就像是噴濺藥水一樣。
我製作了一個稱爲藥水噴霧器的裝置。你需要給它提供一瓶藥水作爲模板，然後給它提供正確類型的源質，它就會製造一定劑量的藥水並存儲在自己內部。在它內部，我最多可以存儲8份劑量的藥水。
在收到紅石信號時，它將會釋放一份劑量的藥水，作用於前方3x3x3的範圍上。

en:
Success! I have created a tool I am calling the Primal Crusher. It has the essential nature of both a pickaxe and a shovel. It does not look like either of those tools, but it defintely functions like them. Better in fact. It is also surprisingly effective against Taint.
It is slightly unpleasant to hold however - it seems to vibrate in one's hand and the feeling becomes quite uncomfortable after a while. A little discomfort will not stop me from using it however.

成功！我創建了一個新的工具，並稱之爲原始杵。它具有鎬和鍬的本質。它看起來不像這些工具中的任何一種，但我確信能像它們一樣使用。事實上效果更好。它對腐化物也有驚人的效果。
然而，它握起來有點不太舒服，似乎會在手上蠕動，而這種感覺過一段時間會變得非常不適。不過，這種不適並不能阻止我使用它。

The variable and malleable nature of Void Metal has openend up some interesting possibilities.
I believe it should be possible to create a tool with inherent morphic instability. In other words it will constantly fluctuate between various states so rapdily that it might not be visible to the naked eye.

en:
For the first time I find myself with a puzzle that I do not think can be solved.
This object contains pure primal aspects, but they possess properties unlike what I consider normal, everyday primal aspects. I have a few theories why this could be:
Firstly this "pearl" could be the remnants of primal matter that was created at the dawn of reality - elementary magic that existed before it mingled and merged into compound aspects.
Alternatively it could be primal matter from a place that does not conform to the known rules of magic as you have come to understand it. I'm not sure which explanation is more worrying.
Either way, the pearl is a potent artifact containing vast magical power and nearly unlimited potential.
It is fairly rare to find a whole one though. Often they have degenerated into nodules or even motes. Even a mote is valuable though.
before:
這是我第一次發現一個我認爲我無法解決的難題。
這個物體包含了純粹的原初要素，但是他們擁有的屬性又不像我認爲正常的，日常見到的原初要素。我有很少的一些理論可以解釋它：
首先，這顆“珍珠”可能是原始物質的殘餘物，它應該是在創世之初被創造出來的——當魔法還只是基礎元素並未混合成複合要素的時候。另一方面，它可能是從一個我們無法理解的，不符合已知魔法世界規則的地方創造出來的。
我不確定哪一種解釋會更讓人擔憂。
無論是哪一種，這顆珍珠確定是一個強大的包含着無窮魔力和幾乎無限潛力的神器。
然而這顆珍珠非常罕見，想找到一顆完整的是相當困難的。它們通常退化爲小顆粒甚至微塵。不過即使是微塵也是有價值的。

en: I have always been curious about the seemingly negative reaction between mystical devices and redstone signals. I should study this phenomenon further and find a practical use for its effects.

en:
§oPaving Stone of Travel§r
By altering the magical structure of arcane stone I am able to create a paving stone that adds new bounce to the step of anyone walking across it.
Anything walking across it will have greater speed and agility for a couple of seconds.§oBarrier Stone§r
I have discovered a way of turning arcane stone blocks into mystical wards that will prevent most creatures from crossing them.
It should be noted that these wards aren't always 100% foolproof and they cannot prevent other players from entering an area, but they keep most common threats at bay. They will also prevent golems from crossing them.
For best results you need an unbroken line of them between the areas you wish to protect and the outside world.
An active redstone signal will disable this block.
The color of the runes above the stone indicates its current status.
Purple runes show that it is currently preventing something from passing through.
Blue runes indicates it has been deactivated with a redstone signal.
Red runes shows that something is preventing it from fully warding an area and a gap exists where something might be able to pass through.
before:
§o旅行者鋪路石§r
通過改變奧術石磚的魔法結構，我成功製造出了可以使任何走過它的人加速通過的鋪路石。
行走於其上時會短暫的提升速度與靈活性。§o屏障石§r
通過改變奧術石磚的魔法結構，我成功將它們轉變成了能夠阻止任何生物通過的奧術屏障。
值得注意的是，這層屏障並不是100%萬無一失，它們也不能阻止其他玩家的進入。他們能夠抵禦常見的威脅，當然，也會阻止傀儡穿過。
爲了達到最佳使用效果，你需要在你想要保護的區域和外部之間建造一條完整的屏障。
可以通過紅石信號來關閉屏障。
屏障石上方的顏色會指示其當前工作狀態。
紫色代表着屏障正在阻止實體穿過。
藍色代表着屏障已經被紅石信號關閉。
紅色代表着當前屏障石的鋪設仍有可以通過的空隙，並不能完全保護這塊區域。
why: Golem 官方譯名為「魔像」，不應譯作「傀儡」；「他們」指屏障應為「它們」。

en:
Before you can build most thaumaturgical items and blocks, you first need to discover how to do so. There are several steps in this process:
(1) Exploring the world and examining blocks, items and creatures with a §5Thaumometer§0

(2) Taking the research points you gathered from the first step and expanding your aspect knowledge with the §5Research Table§0

(3) Using the aspects you know and discovering practical knowledge and recipes with the §5Research Table§0.§l §n(1) Exploration§r

You cannot perform research without research points, and the best way to gain research points is by exploration and examining objects in the world.
The first thing you will need to do is construct a §5Thaumometer§0 (the recipe is listed at the end of this entry). By pointing the §5Thaumometer§0 at objects or creatures and holding the right mouse button you will start examining them. The process does not take long, but your movement speed is reduced while it is occurring.
Once complete the §5Thaumometer§0 will display what aspects the object contains, along with a summary of the aspects and research points you discovered.thaumaturge:textures/research/research1.png:0:0:255:208:.5You will initially not be able to examine all objects since you have not discovered their component aspects. For example, an object containing the Lux aspect can only be examined if you have previously discovered the Lux aspect, or knowthe two aspects that combine to create it.
The very first time you discover an aspect by examining something you gain two more research points than you would have normally.
Objects and creatures can usually only ever be examined once.
Occasionally examining something will reveal additional clues and insights into thaumaturgical research, unlocking subjects that you can research further.§l §n(2) Combining Aspects§r

Once you have gathered some research points you can attempt to combine them into compound aspects within a research table.
To craft a research table simply place two §5wooden tables§0 side by side and click on one of them with a set of Scribing Tools. The recipes for both are listed at the end of this entry.
If you open the research table's inventory, you will see an interface as pictured on the right.
The scribing tools you used to craft the table will be located in slot §l1§r.thaumaturge:textures/research/research2.png:0:0:128:83:1You should see all the primal aspects (and possibly some compound aspects) listed in the area marked §l3§r with varying amounts attached to them. When you enter a world for the first time, every player is assigned a small pool of primal aspects to get them started.
If you had done some exploring withthe thaumometer beforehand then you might have a significant number of primal and compound aspects listed here.
You can now start combining aspects into more complex compound aspects by dragging those you wish to combine to the runic circles in area §l4§r. When you have two selected, pressing the purple button will attempt to combine them. If successful you should see what was gained in the bottom right and it should appear in area §l3§r.
The component aspects are consumed even if the combination did not result in a valid compound aspect.§l §n(3) Primary Research§rthaumaturge:textures/research/research2.png:0:88:255:158:.5You need to be carrying a set of scribing tools and paper for this step.
If you open your Thaumonomicon you will see all the knowledge you have and also all the knowledge that you are now able to pursue.
Research that must be worked out on paper lists its theories on the entry's requirement page.Clicking a listed theory will consume paper and ink from your inventory and you will gain a research note. You can now take this research note to the table to start researching it by placing it in slot §l2§r.
Section §l5§r will now display a sheet of paper covered in hexagonal tiles with aspect icons around the outer edge. If you see question mark icons it means you do not know that aspect yet and you will need to learn it first.To complete your research you simply need to connect and activate all the aspects. You do this by dragging an aspect to a hex adjacent to it that is either composed of the target aspect, or can be combined with another aspect to form the target aspect.thaumaturge:textures/research/research3.png:0:0:150:95:.75Placing an aspect consumes one research point. If you make a mistake you can click on the aspect to remove it, but you will not regain the research point.You continue doing this until you have formed a pattern connecting all the starting aspects. The outer aspects need not be connected to all the others, they simply need to form a connected whole.
Once this is done the research will complete and the research note will turn into a discovery. Using the discovery will commit its knowledge to memory.NOTE: Placing and removing aspects from the hex grid consumes ink from your scribing tools. If it runs out you will not be able to proceed until you refill it.§l §nSecondary Research§r
Not all knowledge requires notes. Simpler subjects instead list a direct cost in aspects on their requirement page. Advancing such research consumes the required research points from your pool directly, and no scribing tools or paper are needed.
before:
在能建造大多數神祕學物品與方塊之前，你首先需要發現如何建造。這一過程分幾個步驟：
（1）探索世界，用§5魔導透鏡§0檢視方塊、物品與生物

（2）取得第一步收集的研究點數，用§5研究台§0擴展你的要素知識

（3）運用你所知的要素，用§5研究台§0發現實用知識與配方。§l§n（1）探索§r

沒有研究點數便無法進行研究，而獲取研究點數的最佳途徑，便是探索並檢視世界中的物體。
你首先要做的，是製作一個§5魔導透鏡§0（配方列於本條末尾）。將§5魔導透鏡§0對準物體或生物，按住鼠標右鍵，你便會開始檢視它們。這一過程無需多久，但檢視期間你的移動速度會降低。
完成後，§5魔導透鏡§0會顯示該物體所含的要素，以及所發現的要素與研究點數的摘要，並附在你發現的內容之後。thaumaturge:textures/research/research1.png:0:0:255:208:.5起初你無法檢視所有物體，因爲你尚未發現它們的組成要素。例如，含有光要素的物體，只有在你已發現光要素，或知曉組合出它的那兩種要素之後，才能被檢視。
第一次通過檢視發現某要素時，你會比平時多得兩個研究點數。
物體與生物通常只能被檢視一次。
偶爾，檢視某物會揭示關於神祕學研究的額外線索與洞見，解鎖可進一步研究的課題。§l§n（2）組合要素§r

收集到一些研究點數後，你就可以嘗試在研究台內將它們組合爲複合要素。
要製作研究台，只需放置一張§5木質桌子§0，再用一套抄寫工具點擊它。兩者的配方都列於本條末尾。
打開研究台的物品欄，你會看到如右圖所示的界面。
你用來製作桌子的抄寫工具會位於§l1§r號槽位。thaumaturge:textures/research/research2.png:0:0:128:83:1你應該能在標註爲§l3§r的區域看到所有原初要素（可能還有一些複合要素）以及附帶的各色數量。當你首次進入世界時，每位玩家都會被分配一小池原初要素作爲起步。
若你事先已用魔導透鏡做過一番探索，那麼這裏列出的原初與複合要素數量或許相當可觀。
現在，你可以把想組合的要素拖到§l4§r區的符文圓圈中，開始將它們組合爲更復雜的複合要素。選定兩個後，按下紫色按鈕便會嘗試組合它們。若成功，你會在右下角看到所得之物，它也會出現在§l3§r區。
即使組合未形成有效的複合要素，組成要素也會被消耗。§l§n（3）基礎研究§rthaumaturge:textures/research/research2.png:0:88:255:158:.5這一步需要你隨身攜帶一套抄寫工具和紙張。
打開祕術寶典，你會看到自己擁有的全部知識，以及當下能夠繼續鑽研的全部知識。
需要在紙上推演的研究，會在條目需求頁列出其理論。點擊列出的理論，會消耗你物品欄中的紙張與墨水，你便會獲得一份研究筆記。現在可以把這份研究筆記拿到研究台，放入§l2§r號槽位，開始研究它。
§l5§r區此時會顯示一張紙，紙上鋪滿六邊形格子，外緣環繞着要素圖標。若你看到問號圖標，說明你尚不認識該要素，需要先學會它。要完成研究，你只需連接並激活所有要素。做法是：把某個要素拖到與其相鄰、且或是由目標要素構成、或是能與另一要素組合成目標要素的六邊形上。thaumaturge:textures/research/research3.png:0:0:150:95:.75放置要素會消耗一個研究點數。若放錯了，可以點擊該要素將其移除，但不會取回研究點數。如此持續，直到你連成一個連接所有起始要素的圖案。外圍要素無需與其他所有要素相連，只需形成一個彼此相連的整體。
完成後，研究便會結束，研究筆記會變成一項發現。使用該發現，便會把它的知識鐫入記憶。注意：在六邊形網格上放置與移除要素，會消耗抄寫工具中的墨水。若墨水耗盡，你將無法繼續，直到重新填充。§l§n次級研究§r
並非所有知識都需要筆記。較簡單的課題會在其需求頁直接列出要素消耗。推進此類研究會直接從你的池中扣除所需研究點數，無需抄寫工具或紙張。
why: 「鼠標」「界面」為大陸用語；研究台需並排放置兩張木質桌子，譯文只寫一張而漏譯；另有一句拆頁後語意走樣。

en: I need to find a way of closing these flux rifts before they grow too large and unstable.
before: 我必須在這些裂痕成長、失控前找到方法關上它們。
why: flux rifts 譯名與同條目 stage_1 的「腐化裂隙」不一致。
sonnet_fix: 我必須在這些腐化裂隙成長、失控前找到方法關上它們。

en:
I have studied the chaotic energies that form these flux rifts and have made an interesting discovery: The rifts themselves are inherently unstable. In theory they will close naturally should they become unstable enough, but the laws of our reality makes this highly unlikely - instead their unstable energy is usually released in smaller bursts. That is probably a good thing - the amount of energy that will be released should a fully unstable rift collapse would be catastrophic.
I think that I have worked out a way to trigger that collapse without the rift needing to be fully unstable - in short, I plan on blowing them up.
No normal explosive will do however - I need an explosive that sends its destructive energies into more than the three normal dimensions. To this end I have designed an explosive I have named the Causality Collapser. This pulsing red sphere needs to be thrown as close to the rift as possible. In theory it will break down the chaotic energies holding the rift together.
Unfortunately my calculations suggest that while collapsing the rift will release large amounts of unstable primal energy - the more unstable the rift, the more chaotic this release will be. I should try and make the rift as stable as possible before detonating the explosive.
before:
我已經研究了從這些腐化裂隙中流出的混亂能量，並且有了一個有趣的發現：裂隙本質上就是不穩定的。理論上來說，當它們變得足夠不穩定時將會自然地閉合，但現實規律使得這極不可能發生 —— 相反，它們的不穩定能量通常以較小的爆發而釋放。這可能是件好事 —— 如果一個完全不穩定的裂隙崩塌，那麼釋放出來的能量將是災難性的。
我想我已經找到了一種不需要裂隙達到完全不穩定狀態而觸發崩潰的方法。 —— 簡而言之，我打算把它們炸掉。
但是，普通的爆炸物做不到 —— 我需要一個破壞性能量能夠超越三維的爆炸物。爲此，我設計了一種名爲 悖論物質 的爆炸物。這個跳動的紅色球體需要儘可能靠近裂隙拋出。從理論上來說，它將會打破混亂能量將裂隙合上。
不幸的是，我的計算表明，當裂隙崩潰時會釋放大量不穩定的原初能量 —— 裂隙越不穩定，釋放的能量就會越混亂。在引爆爆炸物之前，我應使裂縫儘可能穩定。
why: Causality Collapser 被譯成「悖論物質」（舊版殘稿，與英文不符）；「合上」與原意相反地誤解其作用，且「裂縫」與「裂隙」用詞不一致。

en:
My research into protective magics have led me to discover Runic Shielding. This is not armor in the traditional sense, but a way of enchanting most baubles and armor to create a barrier of magical energy that wards out most types of damage. The shielding has a pool of hit points from which damage is subtracted first, protecting the wearer from all harm. Once this pool is depleted the wearer starts taking damage as normal. The pool replenishes over time and requires vis to replenish its charge, which it draws from the aura.
An object can be enchanted multiple times to increase the amount of protection it offers, though it becomes more expensive each time.
The armor offers no protection from damage suffered due to certain environmental hazards.
before:
對防護法術的研究最終使我發明出符文護盾。它並非傳統意義上的護甲裝備，而是一種佩戴在日常衣物上的符咒，紋章或類似防護物品。這種物品會製造出一個防範絕大多數傷害的魔力屏障。護盾會擁有一個傷害量承受池來先一步減免損傷，以保護佩戴者免受各種傷害。當傷害量承受池耗盡佩戴者纔會開始像平常一樣承受傷害。傷害量承受池隨着時間推移會自己回覆，這同時也需要吸取周圍的靈氣。
一個物品可以被多次附上符文護盾來提升保護強度，然而這非常昂貴，消耗的源質量會隨級別而上升
但符文護盾並不會防護某些特定的環境危害造成的傷害。
why: 譯文把符文護盾說成佩戴在衣物上的符咒或紋章，與原文「附魔飾品與護甲」不符，且多出「源質量」等原文沒有的內容。

en:
Eureka! I have formulated a recipe for what I have named Sanity Soap (patent pending).
This soap cleans the flesh, but the effects it has on the psyche is what truly makes it special. When used it has a small chance of reducing non-permanent warp and will remove all temporary warp.
Using it while under the effects of a Warp Ward or while standing in Purifying Fluid will increase your odds.

en:
These red-robed cultists have been popping up of late. Their goals are unknown to me and they seem unwilling to talk. Beyond that there is something... wrong about them. Their grip on sanity seems tenuous at best, but the wrongness goes much deeper than that. It is hard to describe.
My presence seems to enrage them and I believe it might have something to do with my capacity for thaumaturgy.
Their clerics are also capable of wielding magic and I can sense that they are drawing it from the aura, but the magic itself does not seem to be thaumaturgy. Whatever it is, it makes my skin crawl and I can feel the aura buckling and tearing every time they draw upon it.
Some of them seem to carry a book around. I should try and get my hand on one of those, maybe it will tell me more about this strange cult. I should be careful though, some knowledge can be dangerous.
before:
這些身着紅衣的邪教徒最近來到了這個世界。我並不知道他們想要什麼，看上去也不願意交談。除此之外這些人好像…也不太正常。他們對於理智的控制微不足道，不過他們還有更多詭異的地方。這一切很難形容。
我的存在似乎激怒了他們，我相信這與我對神祕學的瞭解脫不了干係。
緋色教徒也同樣能夠施展法術，我能夠感受到他們正在吸取靈氣的能量，但是他們的法術似乎並不屬於神祕學的範疇。 無論如何，他們讓我毛骨悚然，並且我能夠感受到他們在吸取靈氣時帶來的扭曲和撕裂。
他們中有些人似乎帶着一本書，我應該想辦法去搞到一本，也許其中就有更多關於這個邪教組織的信息。不過我應該謹慎一些，有些知識可能暗藏危機。
why: 「信息」為大陸用語（應為資訊）；clerics 被譯成「緋色教徒」、「撕裂」對象也與原文不符。

en:
Eldritch Crabs, or Helmed Crabs, are a most unusual and unnatural creature. I am convinced these creatures are the result of magical tinkering.
A pair of powerful claws make them dangerous to face in combat, but it is how they use those claws that make them horrific. They leap at their foes heads in an attempt to decapitate them. If successful they are somehow able to burrow into the victims body and take control of what remains. Their abdomen looks much like a helmed head allowing them to disguise the true nature of the husk they now control.
These husks are not much more powerful than a normal zombie so the reason why they do this eludes me - they are much more of a threat without their 'mount'. Possibly they were created as weapons of terror by some demented inventor?
before:
異象爪牙和爪牙頭目是最不尋常和不自然的生物。我敢肯定這些生物是邪惡的魔法造物。
一對強大的爪子使它們在面對交戰時變得非常危險，但是要知道它們如何使用這對爪子會讓人覺得更可怕。 它們兇猛撲向敵人並企圖斬殺掉敵人的頭顱。 如果成功了，它們會侵入被害者的身體並控制剩下的驅殼。 它們的腹部看起來像一個戴着頭盔的頭，使它們在驅殼中僞裝的更真實。
這些驅殼跟普通的殭屍相比並不太強，所以這也是爲何它們會逃避我——他們沒有驅殼僞裝的時候會更有威脅。可能它們是被瘋狂的發明家創造出來作爲恐怖分子的武器？
why: Eldritch Crabs/Helmed Crabs 被譯成「異象爪牙和爪牙頭目」，與標題「異象魔蟹」不一致；「它們會逃避我」等句與原意不符。
sonnet_fix:

一對強大的鉗爪使它們在戰鬥中非常危險，但真正令人毛骨悚然的是它們使用鉗爪的方式。它們會撲向敵人的頭部，企圖將其斬首。若成功，它們不知怎麼就能鑽進受害者的身體，操控剩下的軀殼。它們的腹部看起來很像戴着頭盔的頭，使它們能偽裝所操控軀殼的真實本質。
這些軀殼並不比普通殭屍強多少，所以它們爲何要這麼做，我實在想不通 —— 沒有「坐騎」時，它們反而更具威脅。也許它們是某位瘋狂發明家製造出來的恐怖武器？

一對強大的鉗爪使它們在戰鬥中非常危險，但真正令人毛骨悚然的是它們使用鉗爪的方式。它們會撲向敵人的頭部，企圖將其斬首。若成功，它們不知怎麼就能鑽進受害者的身體，操控剩下的軀殼。它們的腹部看起來很像戴着頭盔的頭，使它們能偽裝所操控軀殼的真實本質。

en:
Fire bats, or Hellbats, are usually found in the Nether. Engulfed in flame and unreasonably aggressive they are perfectly suited to the environment they live in. They also have the alarming tendency to explode when attacking.
One wonders what possible evolutionary advantage exploding gives them as a species, but the same can be asked of creepers.

en:
Crafting scepters are specialized wands made to be used to craft mystical objects and nothing else. Foci cannot be attached to them, but they have several features that still make them worthwhile using.
Firstly, they have an additional 10%% vis discount above and beyond what their caps would normally grant.
Secondly they are able to hold 50%% more vis than their cores would normally allow.
Like other wands they can be crafted using most combinations of rods and caps - just a few examples are given here.

en:
This seal commands golems to break any blocks they find in the area.
The hardness of a block determines how quickly it can be broken.
It is possible to filter the type of blocks to be broken or ignored.
It should be noted that due to factors like golem mobility, limited area, and speed, this seal probably will not make a very effective mining tool, though it could be used as such in a pinch.

en:

A specific item can be filtered so it is removed, or excluded from removal.

這個印記的功能與儲存印記相反。它會指示附近的傀儡拿出該容器中的物品。你必須使用其他印記來告訴傀儡如何處理手上的物品，你需要使用其他的印記來告訴傀儡要把手上的物品怎麼樣，否則傀儡會一直拿着它。

en:
A refinement of the §5Block Breaker§0 seal, the Lumberjack seal will only target wooden logs, but instead of breaking the log the golem is hitting, it will instead break the furthest connected log.
This means that it is highly effective when used to harvest trees, as it will effectively chop them from the top down.

這意味着它可以從上到下高效地砍伐樹木。

en:
This seal is similar to the Empty seal, except it will only remove an item from the inventory if there is a specific need for it.
Certain seals may request provisioning. If they require specific items for their tasks a secondary task will be created telling a nearby golem to retrieve those items from any inventories marked with a Provide seal.
This task will use the requesting seals priority and the golem needs to meet the requirements for both the Provider seal and the requesting seal.
The filter on the Provide seal is merely used to compare what items may be taken from the container. The filters (if any) on the requesting seal will determine the exact item taken.

這項指令的優先度取決於提出需求的印記，並且執行該任務的傀儡必須同時滿足這兩個印記的所有特性需求。
供給印記的篩選僅指定哪些物品可以被取出。具體的目標物品取決於提出需求的印記。

en:
This seal can be placed on the side of a container. It will designate the container as a possible destination for any items that golems nearby happen to be holding. As long as the container can accept it, the golems will deliver the item.
You can filter out certain items using a white- or blacklist.
For the white list you can also specify a specific number of items that must be placed in the inventory. By default this number is infinite (marked with a gold star).
If placed against a non-container block the golem will simply drop items at that location.
Like with inventories you can also specify a specific number of items with the white list. Any items located in the world within a 1 block radius of the seal will be counted.

你可以通過黑/白名單來設置該容器可接受的物品類型。

en:
This core pulses with latent energy.
It combines all the features of the lesser stave cores - it has the vis storage capacity of the silverwood core and is able to replenish its vis stores like the various primal wand cores.
Lastly it adds one level of potency to any foci used with it.
This is truly a potent tool in any thaumaturge's arsenal.
Note: You still need to add caps to this stave rod, just like you would for a wand.
before:

en:
Wands are the stock and trade of the thaumaturge, but sometimes you want more bang for your buck. Magical staves are basically just bigger wands. They are able to store more vis.
Since they are physically larger and sturdier than a wand, they can actually be used as weapons in an emergency.
Unfortunately this also makes them unsuitable for the intricate workmanship and fine control required by an arcane workbench or similar crafting.
A staff made from greatwood has more than double the vis storage potential of a greatwood wand, being able to store up to 125 vis of each type, elemental staff cores store 175, and silverwood cores a full 250.
Note: You still need to add caps to a stave rod, just like you would for a wand.

en:
These purple slimes are a strange offshoot of their green cousins. Normal slimes form from the organic gunk that occasionally collects in caves, but Thaumic Slimes are formed from the purple proto-matter residue left over from magical mishaps.
Apart from their strange origins they are rather similar to their green cousins for the most part. They do appear to have the ability to split at will, often spitting a lesser version of themselves at targets that venture too close. If there are no targets nearby, split slimes will endeavour to reform to once again form a larger organism.

en:
I have succeeded in creating a vis battery.
If the local aura is above 95% of its normal capacity the battery will absorb vis and if the aura drops below 75% it will discharge.
There are a few drawbacks however. While it is quicker and a lot more reliable than natural vis crystals, the battery still takes some time to react to changes in the local aura. The second drawback is it's capacity. It can only store 10 points of vis. My attemps to increase this has proven disastrous. I guess this just means that I will need to use them in larger numbers.
Applying a redstone signal to the battery will not only prevent it from functioning, but it will rapidly discharge any vis it is holding back into the aura.

向它通入紅石信號不僅會關閉它，還會使它迅速將它存儲的魔力釋放到周圍的環境中。

en:
The Vis Relay must be placed within eight blocks of an energized node, or within eight blocks of another relay already carrying a stream - chains of relays can carry power a great distance, though each stream can only wind through so many crystals before it frays.
Devices simply drink from the nearest relay. A Recharge Pedestal within reach of a relay will feed its stream directly into any wand resting upon it, and the Arcane Workbench will happily pay crafting costs from a relayed stream before falling back to cruder methods.
The relay itself moves power without loss, but remember the source: an energized node replenishes what is drawn by gulping raw vis from its local aura, and a network that drinks faster than the aura recovers will run the land dry.

en:
Destroying a rift to get Void Seeds is highly impractical. I must find a better way.
While most Crimson Cultist rantings are nonsense, they do make reference to drawing power from rifts. I believe it should be possible to siphon off some of the eldritch energy in rifts to form Void Seeds without destroying the rift outright.
before:
摧毀裂隙以獲得種子是非常不切實際的。我必須找到更好的方法。
雖然大多數緋色教徒都在誇誇其談，但他們確實借鑑吸收了來自裂隙的力量。我相信可以從裂痕中抽取一些異象能量，來形成虛空種子，而且不會徹底地破壞裂隙。

en:
Some experimentation has led to an interesting discovery - the ability to imprint memories in inanimate objects. Your first attempt at using the discovery is doors, pressure plates and other blocks that remember who placed them.
The door can only be removed with a wand by the person who placed it. Additionally the door will refuse to open for anyone but its owner. The owner can also craft iron or gold keys that will grant others access to this door.
By crafting an iron key and clicking on the door, you will link the key to that door.You can then give the key to another person and they will be able to use it on the door to gain permanent permission to open it. They will still not be able to break the door, or grant anyone else access. For that you need the gold key.
The gold key serves much the same function as the iron key, except they can also grant other people iron key access to that door. Only the original owner of the door can hand out gold key access. They are also not able to remove the door with a wand. Only the original owner will be able to do that.This pressure plate has a few novel features.
Firstly it has 3 settings that can be toggled by right-clicking on it: It can trigger on everything (like a wooden pressure plate), just you, or everything except you.
Secondly, like all other warded items only you can remove it.
Lastly it can be linked to other players with the use of keys. These pressure plates can be used to open arcane doors as long as someone with access to the plate has access to the door as well.Warded glass is a simple cosmetic block, but like other warded objects it cannot be broken except by the person who placed it.
Keys cannot be used to give other users access.
before:
一些實驗產生了某個有趣的發現——即向沒有生命的物品印刻記憶的技術。應用這項知識，我首先嚐試着製造出能記住放置者的奧術之扉、奧術壓力板和守衛者方塊。
奧術之扉只能由放置者通過法杖移除。此外它默認會拒絕對主人外的任何人敞開。主人可以通過配製鐵鑰匙或者金鑰匙來分享進門的權限。
合成出鐵鑰匙並拿着它點擊奧術之扉，便能夠將鑰匙與門配對。你可以將鐵鑰匙交給其他人，當他們對這扇門使用鑰匙後便可以獲得進門的永久權限。但他們並不能破壞這扇門，也無法向其他人分享進門權限。除非你製作一柄金鑰匙。
金鑰匙大部分功能與鐵鑰匙類似，但使用它的其他人還會獲得向其他玩家分享鐵鑰匙的權限。只有門的最初擁有者纔有權限制作金鑰匙。使用金鑰匙的人也無法用法杖拆掉奧能之門，那也是最初擁有者的特權。奧術壓力板有一些新奇的特性。
首先通過右鍵點擊可以切換它的三種模式： （像木質壓力板一樣）什麼都能觸發它的模式、僅僅只有主人能觸發的模式、以及除了主人外均可以觸發的模式。
其次，類似其他守衛者系列的物品，只有主人才能移除它。
最後，它也能夠通過鑰匙綁定到其他玩家身上。這些壓力盤能夠用來開啓奧術之扉，只要踩上壓力盤的人本身也有進入這扇門的權限。守衛者玻璃並非單純的裝飾方塊，類似其他守衛者系列物品，它也無法被放置者外的人破壞。
亦無法用鑰匙向他人分享破壞它的權限.

en:
Essentia can be stored in §lWarded Jars§r.
Warded jars can be placed in the world and are able to store essentia virtually indefinitely. The enchantment placed on the jars also makes adding or extracting essentia a breeze.
Jars can be filled from an alembic by clicking with the jar directly on the alembic. They can also be filled and emptied using phials.
What is more they make an excellent storage medium for jams and preserves.
Shift clicking on jars and alembics with an empty hand will empty them.As long as a jar contains some essentia, you can attach a §lJar Label§r to it.
This label will 'lock' the jar to that type of essentia and it will not be able to accept any other kind of essentia.
You can remove a label by shift clicking with an empty hand on the side of the jar containing the label. Take care not to shift click on any other side as it will empty the jar as normal.
You can place a label in a crafting bench with a phial of essentia to assign an aspect to it and when placed on an empty jar it will automatically lock the jar to that aspect. The essentia used in the recipe is not consumed.
Placing it on a filled jar will change the label to the jar's essentia type.
A label can be made blank again by simply placing it by itself in a crafting grid.You can also craft §lBrass Lid Braces§r. When used on a jar, they will prevent essentia being drawn from or placed into the jar by anything other than tubes.
Picking up the jar will remove the brace and return it as an item.
before:
可以用§l源質罐子§r儲存源質。
將源質罐子放置在地上，它能夠非常明瞭直觀地儲存源質。由於魔法的力量，使用或者存放罐子中的源質都是小菜一碟的事情。
手持罐子直接點擊奧術蒸餾器就可以將源質裝進罐中。你也可以使用要素安瓿來填充或清空罐子。
此外它們還非常便於大量而密集地進行源質儲存。
空手狀態下按住潛行鍵Shift點擊罐子或者蒸餾器能夠清空它們。只要罐子裏裝有源質，你就可以貼上§l罐子標籤§r。
標籤將罐子鎖定爲接收特定類型的源質而不再能接收任意其他類型的源質。
空手對着罐子帖着標籤的一面按住潛行點擊，能夠取下標籤。注意如果誤點了其他面會清空罐子裏裝的源質。
你可以對着空罐子使用與某種要素綁定過的標籤（在工作工作台中合成裝有要素的安瓿與標籤），這樣空罐子會自動綁定到這種要素，變成對應的標籤罐子。而標籤上的要素僅僅只是標記，並不真的消耗源質。
對着裝滿了要素的罐子使用，則會把罐子變成和其容納要素相對應的標籤罐子。
綁定過某種要素的標籤只需要放入合成網格參與一次合成就能變回空白標籤。你還可以製作§l黃銅蓋箍§r。當在罐子上使用時，它們將防止通過管以外的任何方式將源質從瓶中抽出或放入瓶中。
撿起罐子將會移除蓋箍並將其作爲一個物品返還。
why: 「virtually indefinitely」被譯成「明瞭直觀」、「jams and preserves」被譯成大量密集儲存，皆與原文不符；另有「工作工作台」「帖」錯字、標籤配方描述與原文出入、「瓶中」應為罐中。

將源質罐子放置在地上，它們能夠幾乎無限期地儲存源質。由於罐子上的附魔，存入或取出源質都是小菜一碟的事情。
手持罐子直接點擊奧術蒸餾器就可以將源質裝進罐中。你也可以使用要素安瓿來填充或清空罐子。
此外它們還是儲存果醬與蜜餞的絕佳容器。

你可以在合成台中將標籤與裝有源質的安瓿一起合成，使標籤綁定某種要素，放在空罐子上時會自動將罐子鎖定為該要素。配方中使用的源質不會被消耗。

撿起罐子將會移除蓋箍並將其作爲一個物品返還。

空手狀態下按住潛行鍵Shift點擊罐子或者蒸餾器能夠清空它們。只要罐子裏裝有源質，你就可以貼上§l罐子標籤§r。
標籤將罐子鎖定爲接收特定類型的源質而不再能接收任意其他類型的源質。
空手對着罐子貼着標籤的一面按住潛行點擊，能夠取下標籤。注意如果誤點了其他面會清空罐子裏裝的源質。
你可以在工作台中將標籤與裝有源質的安瓿一起合成，使標籤綁定某種要素，放在空罐子上時會自動將罐子鎖定為該要素。配方中使用的源質不會被消耗。
放在已裝有源質的罐子上，則會把標籤變成該罐子所含源質的類型。
綁定過某種要素的標籤只需要單獨放入合成網格就能變回空白標籤。你還可以製作§l黃銅蓋箍§r。當在罐子上使用時，它們將防止通過管道以外的任何方式將源質從罐中抽出或放入罐中。
撿起罐子將會移除蓋箍並將其作爲一個物品返還。

en:
I have invented an automated device I have named the Thaumatorium. Like many multi part devices this one must be created using Salis Mundus.
The Thaumatorium is a marvelous invention that allows a thaumaturge to select which formula to use and what catalysts to add. It then automatically draws essentia from available sources using tubes. As long as there is a supply of catalyst, it produces the required object perfectly, every time.
The crucible that forms its base does not require water, but a heat source is still needed.When I access the device there are several slots. The top-left slot is where I place the catalyst. Once I have done this, I can choose which recipe I wish to craft with that catalyst from a list of possibilities that appear below it.
On the right will be shown the essentia required in the order they will be required. It will also display progress bars once the machine is in operation.
The created object is ejected out the front of the device or into an inventory placed in front of the ejection port.Normally a Thaumatorium can only have one active formula, but by attaching a Mnemonic Matrix to its side I can increase the number of formulas it can keep track of. Each matrix increases the number of formulas by 2.

神祕煉金塔是一個奇妙的發明，神祕使可以選擇使用哪種配方和添加哪種觸媒。然後它就會使用管道自動從可用的來源中抽取源質。只要有足夠的觸媒它就可以隨時生產所需物品。

en:
I have penned my own designs based on the little information I could find and my own experimental findings. Time to put theory into practice.
Not only will the goggles reveal hidden things, but they will also reduce the vis cost of certain thaumaturgical tasks.
Lastly these goggles will allow me to see the vis or essentia content of objects in the world which will prove a great boon I am sure.The most important thing I have learned however is the possibility of crafting delicate mechanical devices using magic and imbuing them with arcane power.
before:
我根據僅有的一些信息外加一些個人經驗做出了我的設計，現在，是時候將理論付諸實踐了。
護目鏡不僅能夠揭示一些隱藏的信息，還可以降低特定操作時的魔力消耗。
最後，這副護目鏡能讓我看到物體中蘊含的魔力及源質，我相信這也會是一個不小的幫助。此外，我所學到最重要的知識，便是我能夠通過使用魔法並注入奧術能量來製作精緻的機械裝置。

en:
Slowly but surely I am beginning to understand the nature of Vis. So much is still hidden to me, but I think I now know enough to begin moulding it to my will. For this I will need a tool. A very special tool.
I have stumbled upon some dusty scrolls penned by a long dead thaumaturge. They describe how to craft wands that store and channel vis - and the more I read, the more the design impresses me. A wand is always the combination of a rod and two end-caps. The rod holds the vis, six pools of it, one for each primal aspect, while the caps focus it as it is spent. Different materials should make for better rods and caps, but for a first attempt mundane wood and iron will have to do, poor conductors though they are.
The scrolls also mention crystalline foci that can be socketed into a wand to shape its vis into all manner of useful effects. Brilliant actually. It irks me that I did not think of it first.
Only this basic wand can be put together on a normal crafting table - I suspect anything finer will require the arcane workbench and a cost in vis besides.
before:
我正緩慢而堅定地開始理解魔力的本質。仍有太多對我隱藏，但我想我現在已經懂得足夠多，可以開始將它塑造成我所願。爲此我需要一件工具，一件非常特殊的工具。
我偶然發現了幾卷早已作古的神祕使所寫的蒙塵卷軸。它們描述瞭如何製作儲存與傳導魔力的法杖——我讀得越多，這設計就越令我歎服。法杖總是由一根杖柄和兩個杖端組合而成。杖柄容納魔力，共六個魔力池，每種原初要素一個；杖端則在魔力被消耗時將其聚焦。不同的材料應當能造就更好的杖柄與杖端，但初次嘗試，只得用普通的木與鐵將就——儘管它們是不良導體。
卷軸還提到可以鑲入法杖、將魔力塑造成各種實用效果的核心。實在精妙。讓我懊惱的是，我竟沒有先想到這一點。
只有這種基礎法杖能在普通工作台上拼裝——我懷疑更精良的都需要奧術工作台，並額外消耗魔力。我還需要一個魔力諧振器，來研究能量如何沉澱進杖柄。

en:
I have put together my first casting wand and I am quite pleased with the result. It is rough - iron caps waste a tenth of every drop of vis they channel and the wooden rod holds a mere 25 vis of each primal - but it works.
To fill it I can hold it high and slowly condense the raw aura around me into primal vis, though the process is crude and wasteful. Aura nodes promise a far richer harvest - pointing the wand at one and holding lets me tap the node directly. Creatures slain in battle also shed motes of primal energy that the wand drinks in eagerly, and even the humble vis-bearing plants of the world will give up a little charge when harvested.
While holding the wand, an indicator shows me how much vis rests within, and its tooltip lays out each pool exactly.
The wand has also earned a place at my arcane workbench. Slotted beside the crafting grid, its caps focus the vis the bench draws from the aura, discounting the cost of every arcane recipe. Better still, a charged wand can stand in for vis crystals entirely, paying two vis of the matching primal for each crystal a recipe demands - no crystals consumed at all. Without a wand the workbench still functions, but the work runs unfocused: the crystals are burned as crude catalysts and the aura is taxed a quarter more for my trouble.
My main stumbling block now is that in its current state it is little more than a magical wrench. Until I crack the secret of crafting foci its utility will be limited. The path before me is clear...
before:
我拼裝好了我的第一根法杖，對結果相當滿意。它很粗糙——鐵杖端會浪費所傳導的每一滴魔力中的十分之一，木杖柄每種原初要素也只能容納區區25點——但它能用。
要給它充能，我可以將它高舉，緩緩把周圍原始靈氣凝聚爲原初魔力，儘管過程粗糙而浪費。靈氣節點則許諾遠爲豐厚的收成——把法杖指向一個節點並按住，就能直接抽取節點。戰鬥中喪生的生物也會散落原初能量的微粒，法杖會急切地吞下它們；甚至連世界上那些卑微的含魔力植物，在採收時也會交出些許能量。
手持法杖時，會有一個指示器顯示其內所含魔力的多少，其提示框則精確列出每個魔力池。
法杖在奧術工作台也贏得了一席之地。插在合成網格旁時，其杖端會聚焦奧術工作台從靈氣中抽取的魔力，爲每個奧術配方減免消耗。更妙的是，充能的法杖能完全取代魔力水晶，爲配方所需的每顆水晶支付兩點對應原初魔力——水晶完全無需消耗。沒有法杖時工作台仍能運轉，但合成會處於未聚焦狀態：水晶被當作粗糙催化劑燒掉，靈氣還得多付四分之一的損耗。
我眼下最大的障礙是，就目前的狀態而言，它不過是把魔法扳手。在破解制作核心的祕密之前，它的用處將十分有限。前路已然清晰…
why: 「制作」應為「製作」；Focus 應譯為「法器」

法杖在奧術工作台也贏得了一席之地。插在合成網格旁時，其杖端會聚焦奧術工作台從靈氣中抽取的魔力，爲每個奧術配方減免消耗。更妙的是，充能的法杖能完全取代魔力水晶，爲配方所需的每顆水晶支付兩點對應原初魔力——水晶完全無需消耗。沒有法杖時工作台仍能運轉，但合成會處於未聚焦狀態：水晶被當作粗糙催化劑燒掉，靈氣還得多付四分之一的損耗。
我眼下最大的障礙是，就目前的狀態而言，它不過是把魔法扳手。在破解製作法器的祕密之前，它的用處將十分有限。前路已然清晰…

en:
I have unlocked the key to creating stable and relatively leak-free tubing. While mundane chemicals can be transported in glass, certain types of essentia either dissolve or simply pass right through it. By wrapping the glass in iron and treating it with quicksilver I have managed to protect it from even the most volatile types of essentia. Brass fittings finish off the piping system and makes it visually appealing.The tubes can be connected to all manner of alchemical devices, though warded jars and alembics are their primary targets.
Essentia flows through the tubes whenever something is connected to them that can accept it, like warded jars.
Jars containing different kinds of essentia will only draw their kind of essentia towards them. Tubes however can only draw and transport one kind of essentia at a time - the highest drawing strength will take priority. Without the proper use of valves it is quite easy for a network of tubes to get gummed up. The use of valves is essential.
When you see gasses being vented from a tube, it means different kinds of suction are interfering with each other. The color gives a clue as to the types of suction that is causing the problem.Tubes can be connected and disconnected from their neighbors by clicking on a section of tubing with a wand.
The wand can also be used to click on the central section to rotate certain tubes like the valve.thaumaturge:textures/item/resonator.png:0:0:255:255:.125The Essentia Resonator is handy for troubleshooting your tube network. You can use it on a tube or other essentia using device to see what essentia it currently contains and the suction it is applying.thaumaturge:textures/item/tube_valve.png:0:0:255:255:.125The essentia valve acts much like a normal length of tubing, except it can be turned off by hand or a redstone signal. When this is done the flow of essentia through it will be cut off.thaumaturge:textures/item/tube_filter.png:0:0:255:255:.125Filtered essentia tubes work like normal tubes, except it is possible to mark them with labels, phials or other items that clearly identify a single type of essentia. When marked they will restrict essentia flow through them to what they have been marked with.
Shift-clicking on them with an empty hand will remove the filter.thaumaturge:textures/item/tube_restrict.png:0:0:255:255:.125Restricted essentia tubes work like normal tubes, except they halve the any suction passing through them.thaumaturge:textures/item/tube_oneway.png:0:0:255:255:.125Directional essentia tubes only accept suction from one direction. The blue markings indicate the direction from which suction will be accepted.thaumaturge:textures/item/tube_buffer.png:0:0:255:255:.125The essentia buffer allows you to store a limited amount of essentia - 8 points total, though it can be made up of any combination of essentia types. Like a jar it has suction, though it applies the minimum amount of suction possible (1).
This means that is usually only able to draw essentia from an essentia source it is directly attached to. However tubes can be connected to all its sides, meaning that it is invaluable for getting essentia out of devices that could contain variable types of essentia.
You can attach bellows to the buffer - each attached bellows increases its suction by 32.
Additionally you can toggle individual connections on and off as with a normal tube, but if you shift click a connection, it will choke the suction back to 1 (blue band) or 0 (red band) on that side.
This allows for some interesting possibilities when routing essentia.
before:
我掌握了製造穩定且相對防漏的管道的關鍵。雖然世俗化學品可以用玻璃輸送，但某些類型的源質要麼會溶解玻璃，要麼直接穿透它。用鐵包裹玻璃並用水銀處理之後，我成功讓它抵禦住哪怕最易揮發的源質類型。黃銅管件則爲管道系統收尾，使其賞心悅目。管道可以連接到各種煉金裝置，不過源質罐子與蒸餾器是它們的主要對象。
每當有能接納源質的東西（比如源質罐子）接到管道上時，源質便會流經管道。
盛有不同種類源質的罐子，只會把屬於自己的那類源質吸向自己。而管道一次只能抽取並輸送一種源質——抽取力度最大者優先。若不善用閥門，管道網絡極易堵塞。閥門的使用至關重要。
當你看到氣體從管道中排出時，說明不同種類的吸力正在互相干擾。顏色會給出造成問題的吸力類型的線索。用杖點擊某段管道，可以把它與相鄰管道連接或斷開。
杖也可用於點擊中央部分，以旋轉閥門等某些管道。thaumaturge:textures/item/resonator.png:0:0:255:255:.125源質諧振器在排查管道網絡故障時十分好用。你可以對管道或其他使用源質的裝置使用它，查看其當前所含源質及施加的吸力。thaumaturge:textures/item/tube_valve.png:0:0:255:255:.125源質閥門的作用與普通管道段很相似，只不過可以手動或用紅石信號關閉。關閉後，流經其中的源質便會被切斷。thaumaturge:textures/item/tube_filter.png:0:0:255:255:.125過濾源質管道的工作方式與普通管道相同，只不過可以用標籤、安瓿或其他明確標識單一源質類型的物品來標記它們。被標記後，它們會把流經的源質限制爲所標記的類型。
空手潛行點擊它們，會移除過濾器。thaumaturge:textures/item/tube_restrict.png:0:0:255:255:.125限定源質管道的工作方式與普通管道相同，只不過會把穿過其中的任何吸力減半。thaumaturge:textures/item/tube_oneway.png:0:0:255:255:.125定向源質管道只從一個方向接受吸力。藍色標記標示着接受吸力的方向。thaumaturge:textures/item/tube_buffer.png:0:0:255:255:.125源質緩存器允許你存儲有限數量的源質——總計8點，不過可以由任意類型的源質組合而成。它像罐子一樣有吸力，只不過施加的是儘可能小的吸力（1）。
這意味着它通常只能從直接相連的源質來源抽取源質。但管道可以連接到它的所有面，因此在從可能盛有多種源質類型的裝置中引出源質時，它堪稱無價。
你可以爲緩存器加裝風箱——每加裝一個風箱，其吸力便增加32。
此外，你可以像普通管道一樣逐個開關連接，但若潛行點擊某個連接，便會把該側的吸力壓回1（藍環）或0（紅環）。
這在輸送源質時提供了不少有趣的可能。
why: 大陸用語：網絡→網路、存儲→儲存、緩存器→緩衝器、信號→訊號

en:
My recent discoveries have given me a new insight into how the world is put together and I think I might know a way to transform matter by altering its Essentia.
This will require experimentation and something to hold the alchemical substrate. A simple brewing stand will not do - what I need is a mystical crucible.
A cauldron is the right shape and size, but what is effectively a big metal bowl will never be able to hold the magical energies I wish to manipulate.
Once again, applying some Salis Mundus to a cauldron should resolve my problems.
before:
我最近的發現讓我進一步瞭解世界是如何融爲一體的，我想我知道一種通過改變源質來轉化物質的方法。
這一切都需要進一步的實驗，並且需要一個能夠存儲煉金基質的東西。一個基礎的釀造臺並沒有這樣的功能 — 我想我需要的是一個神祕的坩堝。
煉藥鍋的大小和容量看起來不錯，但是我要如何才能夠讓這個巨大的金屬容器保存我想要操縱的魔法能量呢。
我想，再撒上一把世界鹽應該就能解決我的問題了。
why: Cauldron 官方譯名為「鍋釜」；「存儲」為大陸用語

這一切都需要進一步的實驗，並且需要一個能夠儲存煉金基質的東西。一個基礎的釀造台並沒有這樣的功能 — 我想我需要的是一個神祕的坩堝。
鍋釜的大小和容量看起來不錯，但是我要如何才能夠讓這個巨大的金屬容器保存我想要操縱的魔法能量呢。

en:
I have my crucible! Now I need something to experiment with, and I happen to have the perfect thing. I have spent many a late-night studying thaumaturgy and flickering torchlight is not the best thing to read by. A steady magical light is exactly what I need now.
Glowstone is a steady source of light, but I require large handfuls of it for a light source and it lacks... style. I am sure I can alter it into something better.
The crucible needs to be placed over a source of heat and filled with water. Once the water boils I can start adding the things I need. I have jotted down a recipe that I think will create a substance I have named Nitor. A small core of energized glowstone empowered with energy, fire and light should burn forever. It should be naturally buoyant, allowing it to be placed wherever I choose - even floating in mid-air.
I simply need to find objects with the required essentia (pressing shift whilst hovering over an item might help here) and throw them into the crucible.
The crucible will render them down into their constituent essentia. I might not be able to gather the exact combination of essentia I require, but if there are enough of the types I need everything should be fine.
Once I have enough all I need to do is throw in the catalyst. In this case a handful of glowstone dust.
If all goes well the glowstone will absorb the essentia and transform into nitor.
I am not sure what will happen to the excess essentia, but I can only assume it will eventually dissolve harmlessly.
[Shift-right clicking with an empty hand will empty a crucible. Each crafting operation will consume some of the water so you will have to replenish it now and again.]
before:
我現在擁有屬於自己的坩堝了！現在我需要進行一些新的常識，並且我恰好有一個不錯的主意。最近我徹夜學習神祕學，那火把發出的微弱光芒太傷眼睛了，我想我現在需要一個穩定的魔法光源。
熒石是一種穩定的光源，但是如果我把它們放得到處都是，這也…太丟範了…我很肯定我能夠把它們變成一些更酷的東西。
坩堝需要放置在熱源上並且盛滿水，一旦裏面的水開始沸騰，我就可以開始添加我想要的東西了。我記下了一個我認爲能創造出我想要的東西的配方，我將這個新東西命名爲“閃耀之光”，一個微小的熒石核心包裹在魔力之中，永遠發光發熱。它應當能夠自然地飄浮，這讓我能夠把它放在任何我需要的地方 — 即使是懸浮在半空中也沒問題。
我只需要尋找具有特定源質的物體（鼠標放在物品上按住Shift鍵就能夠獲得提示）並將他們扔進坩堝。
坩堝將會把他們分解成所具備的源質，我可能沒辦法精確控制我所需要的源質數量，但坩堝裏面只要有我所需要的所有源質應該就不會有問題了。
當坩堝裏有足夠的源質之後，我就可以投入觸媒了。而現在，我需要做的是投入一些熒石粉。
如果一切順利的話，熒石就會吸收源質並轉化爲閃耀之光了。
我不確定多餘的源質在坩堝中會發生什麼，不過我只能假設它們最終會無害地消散到空氣中。
[按住Shift右鍵點擊坩堝會將其清空，每個合成操作都會消耗一些坩堝中的水，所以你需要反反覆覆地補充坩堝中的水]
